**Previous release: [1.4.256](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.256)** — Easier on-device dictation setup and earlier long-chat performance improvements.

## Smoother long chats, saved feedback and better dictation ✨

Orca 1.4.257 reduces freezes when several long Chat UI conversations stream at once. If you keep multiple agents working in conversations with a lot of history, this update cuts the work Orca does as their replies arrive.

- 🌐 **Keep your browser feedback across restarts:** Unsent text notes on pages in Orca’s browser now return after a reload or restart. Closing a tab with unsent notes asks before discarding them, so you can leave feedback and come back to it later. Agents running on your desktop can read those notes with `orca tab annotations` before you press Send.
- 🎙️ **Give yourself time to think while dictating:** In **Settings → Voice → Input → Stop After Silence**, choose 30 seconds, one minute, two minutes or Off. Dictation can wait through a longer pause while you compose a message or terminal command. The same settings page adds a **Test** button to record and play back your microphone, with a transcript when your speech model is ready.
- ⌨️ **Paste while a terminal connects:** A command pasted into a starting or reconnecting terminal now waits for its shell instead of being dropped. This covers local, SSH and remote terminals for pastes up to 64 KB; larger pastes still need a connected terminal.
- 🗂️ **Automate folder workspace routines:** Configured setup scripts now run when you create a folder workspace, including through the CLI. Archive scripts run before removal. Use them to prepare the project and run its cleanup routine; these scripts operate in the shared project folder.

## Highlights

- **Find what belongs in a split pane:** Press `/` in an empty split pane to search for an agent or file. Use the arrow keys and Enter to open your selection without leaving the keyboard.
- **Keep your chosen Claude model:** The Chat UI picker keeps your latest selection when replies from an earlier turn arrive, rather than snapping back to their model.
- **See the images you asked Codex to make:** Generated images remain visible after a turn finishes, without expanding its tool details. For remote chats, update both the host and client to get this behavior.

---

body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.37

Released on 2026-11-12.

Sharing refuses to build an archive when it can't read `.hyperframesignore`, so ignored files stay out. `templates pull` also refuses archives that hold links.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** `hyperframes templates pull` refuses an archive that holds anything other than plain files and folders, such as a symlink, hard link or device entry. Nothing is unpacked, and no partial folder is left behind. A link inside a pulled template could otherwise let preview, render and publish reach files elsewhere on your machine ([ab66e5bd7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ab66e5bd72ad16b36a37dd1ee50d23cc21b41bb0), [#7576](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7576)).
- **Share:** `snapshotProject` and `snapshotFiles` throw `invalid_source_ignore` again when `.hyperframesignore` can't be read. In 0.9.35 they skipped the unreadable file, so an archive built from the snapshot could include files the ignore file meant to leave out. Hosts that use these functions only for change detection should pass `{ lenientIgnore: true }` to keep the 0.9.35 behavior. `projectFingerprint` already does ([35cf03cab](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/35cf03cab9e75a4f21fc90cf0dac8a08310ab6ad), [#7573](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7573)).

# HyperFrames v0.9.35

Released on 2026-11-11.

Private files like `.env` and git data stay out of preview bundles, and local sharing only answers your own machine. Sharing also keeps tracking changes when `.hyperframesignore` uses gitignore patterns.

## Fixes

- **Security:** Preview bundles never include `.env` files or git data, even through a link. A render that names one of these files now stops with an error. Local sharing only answers this machine, so sharing from Studio in a container now gets a 403 ([a243169f8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a243169f8a10fa26fe9e9d1d1623d68445e2a3c7), [#7563](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7563)).
- **Security:** Helper programs are found by walking your trusted `PATH` folders directly. On Windows, the working folder is never searched ([9a048ac01](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9a048ac019e919f9e9c37b1b764172676434511e), [#7562](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7562)).
- **Share:** Change detection keeps working when `.hyperframesignore` uses gitignore patterns such as `/exports/` or `**/*.mov`. Before, those patterns stopped it with an error ([c07468d6a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c07468d6a7155d28828eef1058896b7aa74114a1), [#7568](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7568)).
- **CLI:** Durations and sizes roll over to the next unit when rounded, so you see `1m 0.0s` and `1.0 MB`, not `60.0s` and `1024.0 KB` ([182608311](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/182608311ad9781669b26288a944cc85f28ab1cd), [#7565](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7565)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Studio App:** The brand kits page says kits are shared with your workspace only ([c218b37a3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c218b37a319661280f337a3304bb7a4f566bddf5), [#7570](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7570)).

## Internal

- **Core:** The preview runtime offers its parent a typed message port. This prepares Studio for a sealed preview frame and changes nothing yet ([ef5cdeb0a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ef5cdeb0a02afc993980809cc359dd68a1c4944d), [#7556](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7556)).
- **CLI:** Local Studio's share window counts button clicks and choices. Only fixed categories are recorded, never links, paths or email addresses ([2a70733c1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2a70733c15798430e1fae817bc65f1bf90acbed6), [#7566](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7566)).

name: v2.0.0 - Skills in .agents/skills, /opsx commands removed
body:
# OpenSpec 2.0

OpenSpec now installs skills in `.agents/skills/` instead of keeping a separate copy for each coding agent. Tools that don't read this folder, like Claude Code and Kiro, get links to the same skills.

We're also removing the `/opsx:*` slash commands. Each command already has a matching skill, so there's no need to maintain both.

The OpenSpec workflows themselves haven't changed.

## What changed

- **Skills are installed in `.agents/skills/`.** Every tool uses the same skills, without duplicate files across folders.
- **`/opsx:*` commands are removed.** For example, `/opsx:propose` becomes `/openspec-propose` (or `$openspec-propose` in Codex). You can also just ask your agent for the work.
- **`openspec update` removes files generated by older versions.** This includes old slash commands and duplicate skills. Files you've changed in the old locations are kept and listed.
- The `delivery` setting is no longer needed. Existing configs keep working.
- Amazon Q Developer support is removed because it can't load skills. We recommend Kiro instead.

## How to upgrade

Update the OpenSpec CLI, then run this in each project and commit the changes:

```bash
openspec update
```

To preview the changes first, run `openspec update --dry-run`.

**Note:** if you edited OpenSpec's skills directly in `.agents/skills/`, `openspec update` overwrites those edits. Save them before upgrading.

See the [upgrade guide](https://openspec.dev/docs/upgrade-to-2) for more details.

## Fixes

- `openspec completion install` no longer edits PowerShell profiles when run from Windows cmd.exe.
- `openspec instructions apply` no longer cuts off tasks that span several lines in `tasks.md`.

**Full changelog:** [v1.17.0...v2.0.0](https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/compare/v1.17.0...v2.0.0)

name: v18.19.0
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added the `liquid-systemone` judgment API for Liquid AI decision models, including validation that rejects image sets exceeding Liquid’s 10,000 32×32-patch request limit before submission.

### Fixed

- Fixed Gemini CLI and Antigravity responses losing or misordering thought signatures and reply text, including responses that follow tool calls.
- Fixed Gemini CLI and Antigravity merging reply text around a thought signature, dropping signatures at the start of a reply or after a tool call, and placing a thought ahead of reply text that streamed before it ([#18942](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18942) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- Fixed Google Antigravity judging Gemini models by quota buckets they do not consume: Gemini 3.x requests ignore the Gemini 4 Argon weekly bucket, and Argon requests ignore `gemini-weekly`, so an exhausted or low bucket no longer blocks, reserves, or caps an account for the other models ([#16104](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16104)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added Liquid AI provider support with the d1.1 and d1-ultra judge models and Liquid authentication via `/login liquid` using `LIQUID_API_KEY`.

### Fixed

- Fixed Google Antigravity Gemini 4 Argon models sharing the general Gemini quota scope instead of their dedicated weekly bucket ([#16104](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16104)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Breaking Changes

- Changed the browser `open` API: `ignore_https_errors` is now `insecure`, `allow_file_access` has been removed, and `file:` pages can access other local files.
- Changed the browser `open` and `targets` `app` option from an object to a string or CDP endpoint/executable path. Use `argv` instead of `app.args` and the top-level `target` instead of `app.target`.
- Removed `task.file` and the task tool's `taskFile` field; subagent instructions must now be provided inline.
- Removed blocked todo tasks and the `blocked` status/blocker metadata. Existing blocked tasks are restored as pending.

### Added

- Added `systemPromptTemplates`, which maps model-selector patterns to Handlebars template files for customizing system prompts. Templates re-render when switching models, with warnings and fallback to the bundled prompt for missing or invalid templates.
- Added ordered multi-step tasks through `task.steps`. Subagents receive steps sequentially, and the final step determines the task result; interrupted tasks resume with their remaining steps.
- Added Liquid AI judge models `liquid/d1.1` and `liquid/d1-ultra`, including image resizing for Liquid's request limits.
- Added per-step progress, state, and duration reporting for GitHub Actions watches, with expandable details and native Tern Surface Protocol views.
- Added `task.autoParallel` (`off`, `suggest`, or `on`) to identify subtasks that can run concurrently and optionally delegate them in a single parallel task call.
- Added portable `awk`, `tar`, `lsof`, `shasum`, `md5`, and `strings` support to the `bash` tool, including Windows support and internal-URI paths.

### Changed

- Browser sessions now prefer the bundled ABKit WebKit engine when available, with automatic installation and SHA-256 verification. WebKit provides headed, user-visible tabs and broader browser compatibility; Chromium remains the fallback and can be selected explicitly with `app: "chromium"`, while `app: "webkit"` requires WebKit. Configure this behavior with `browser.webkit` and `browser.webkitPath` or the corresponding environment variables.
- Browser visibility controls now show or hide WebKit tab windows immediately. Headed WebKit tabs can be interacted with directly, while Chromium tabs retain their existing mode-switching behavior.
- In Tern environments with native DOM access, browser observation and interaction use trusted native input across frames and closed shadow roots, with caret-aware typing and case-insensitive text selectors.
- `edit.modelVariants` now uses the longest matching model pattern, so specific patterns take precedence over generic ones regardless of configuration order.
- The `ask` tool now submits the form's current values when its timeout expires; updated settings and documentation reflect this behavior.
- The `read` tool loads detailed format selectors and URI sub-path syntax on demand, reducing the default request description while retaining inline details when `read` is disabled.
- The default system prompt and tool descriptions have been streamlined, with guidance moved closer to the tools and detailed task/procedure references provided when relevant.
- The `bash` pseudo view renders words built from literals and expansions as f-strings (`f"repos/org/{r}/rulesets"`) instead of `concat(...)` calls.

### Fixed

- Fixed `computer.close()` so subsequent computer-control calls start a fresh desktop session instead of failing.
- Fixed extension providers with `oauth.modifyModels` so they do not load the full model catalog before login.
- Fixed resuming sessions so it no longer scans unrelated later session transcripts.
- Fixed session saving on Windows to avoid UI stalls caused by repeated session-file access.
- Fixed automatic chart selection so generated charts use compatible data and chart types.
- Fixed `bash` previews for `env -i` commands so they display the requested command rather than generated shell setup code.

## @oh-my-pi/collab-web

### Fixed

- Fixed `task` tool cards so spawned tasks consistently display their name, assigned agent, and instructions, with `steps` spawns shown as numbered stages.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added `shellBuiltins(sessionEnv?)` to list commands provided by the embedded shell, including process controls and utilities.
- Expanded the embedded shell with `awk`, `tar`, `shasum`, `md5`, `strings`, and `lsof` across Linux, macOS, and Windows. Destructive utilities can be disabled with `PI_DISABLE_UUTILS_DESTRUCTIVE`; when disabled, `tar` is delegated to the system.

### Fixed

- Fixed macOS text entry in Chrome and other Chromium-based applications so typing followed by Return opens the entered text instead of reloading the current page.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- GitHub Actions watch cards now show current-step progress and can be expanded with Ctrl+O to display ordered step states and durations in ANSI and native Tern views.

### Fixed

- Fixed comparison charts mislabeling gaps against a rival column as improvements or regressions.
- Fixed Tern edit diffs showing unrelated one-line hunks and incorrect line numbers around distant changes.
- Fixed table charts incorrectly interpreting words such as “with,” “to,” and “from” in column names as comparison conditions.
- Fixed chart row names containing trailing numbers, such as “EmbeddingGemma 2” and “Jev 15,” being split or incorrectly nested.
- Fixed `read` rejecting colon-separated line ranges and displaying a single requested range as multiple rows.

### Removed

- Removed the `blocked` status from `TodoStatus`, the `blocker` field from `TodoItem`, and the `block`/`unblock` operations from `TodoOperation`.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added browser utilities exposing trusted browser archive extraction limits and the installed WebKit host executable path.


## What's Changed
* feat(ai,catalog,coding-agent): add Liquid AI (d1-ultra, d1.1) judge provider by @SuperUserA in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18100
* fix(collab): isolate test home directories and guard real ~/.omp paths by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18811
* fix(ai): keep signature-only thought parts as signed thinking on Gemini CLI routes by @JustasMasiulis in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18942
* perf(tui): release regenerable render caches on retired tool cards by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18820
* perf(coding-agent,catalog): keep model cache reads provider-scoped and prune expired legacy rows by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18821
* feat(coding-agent): add per-model system prompt templates by @DeprecatedLuke in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17835
* perf(session): read only headers when looking for a session's continuations by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18952
* feat(github): show step-level Actions watch progress by @anatoli-tsinovoy in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18945
* fix(ai): isolate antigravity argon quota bucket by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16106


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.18.9...v18.19.0

name: v18.18.9
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- Tool calls get `ctx.toolCall.earlierEffectsSettled`, which settles once the earlier calls of their message that run beside them and may write files (their approval, asked with their arguments, is not `read`) have finished; speculative results wait for those effects before validation, and cancellation while waiting prevents their commit ([#16274](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16274) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added `SOFYA_API_KEY` as the env key for the `sofya` provider ([#18185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18185) by [@yusufgurdogan](https://github.com/yusufgurdogan))

### Fixed

- Devin requests no longer send `temperature: 0`: the catalog's `temperature-floor` raises it to `0.0001`, so session titles and Mnemopi memory extraction work on Devin instead of failing with Cascade's opaque `invalid_argument` and silently falling back to another model ([#18423](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18423))
- Auth-gateway `/v1/messages` now answers `400 invalid_request_error` for `output_config.format` (and the pre-GA `output_format`) instead of returning 200 with output the schema never constrained, so structured-output clients fall back to prompt-side schemas ([#18842](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18842))
- Auth-gateway requests denied only the requested model (Codex ChatGPT account, Cursor plan) now switch to another account and keep the denied one usable for other models, instead of marking a working credential suspect; gateway rotation now follows the same rules as local sessions, including waiting out a sibling's short usage block

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added the `web/sofya` search model ([#18185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18185) by [@yusufgurdogan](https://github.com/yusufgurdogan))
- Added the `temperature-floor` compat axis, assigned `0.0001` on Devin so a request that pins `temperature: 0` reaches Cascade as a value it accepts ([#18423](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18423))
- Added the keyless `web/hackernews` search engine model for Hacker News stories and comments

### Fixed

- Devin requests now identify as Devin CLI 3000.12.43, the current stable release, instead of 3000.11.205 ([#18766](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18766) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon on Command Code showing no reasoning levels; both now offer low, medium, and high
- Fixed OpenCode Zen Gemini 4 Carbon requests going to the chat-completions endpoint instead of the native Gemini endpoint Zen serves it on

### Removed

- Removed Devin's retired SWE-1.6 Fast from the models omp lists before Devin's live model list loads (first start, or when Devin is unreachable) ([#18795](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18795) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added Sofya as a web search engine (`web/sofya`), using `SOFYA_API_KEY` or a stored `sofya` credential ([#18185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18185) by [@yusufgurdogan](https://github.com/yusufgurdogan))
- Documented autoresearch mode in [docs/autoresearch.md](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/blob/main/docs/autoresearch.md): activation and its git gates, the three stop conditions, the per-segment iteration cap that defaults to none, the harness `METRIC`/`ASI` contract, and the on-disk store that `OMP_AUTORESEARCH_DB_DIR` relocates ([#18655](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18655) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Extensions can import the form theme, the native span helpers (`styledSpans`, `compactText`, `rowsText` and the rest of the ANSI/span conversions), the `xd://` URL helpers (`parseXdUrl` and friends) and the `cfgExtensionTranscriptPresenters` setting handle from `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent` instead of internal module paths, which stop the extension from loading when a file moves ([#18849](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18849) by [@materemias](https://github.com/materemias))
- `/context` shows loaded instruction files and skills in their own categories; System Prompt marks where each one sits without counting it twice, and notes when an extension or SDK callback changed the prompt after it was built ([#17971](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17971) by [@c-w-z](https://github.com/c-w-z))
- Added Hacker News search (`web/hackernews`): `web_search` queries scoped to `site:news.ycombinator.com` now search HN stories and comments through the keyless HN Search API before the configured engines

### Changed

- A role edit in another omp instance no longer rewrites the `task` and `eval` tool descriptions of every running session, which was invalidating the Anthropic prompt cache from the tool definitions onward and dropping signed thinking blocks on prefix-bound models; the per-call model advertisement is now frozen into the base prompt surface and changes only when that surface rebuilds ([#18716](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18716), [#18732](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18732) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Agent-to-agent messages now always reach the recipient as user turns: one that ends a `wait` arrives right after it instead of inside the `wait` tool result, and none is sent with developer or system authority
- Launch services now persist for non‑interactive sessions
- The shell's built-in `jq` now behaves like jq 1.8.2 instead of jaq: the same output (number formatting, colors, `-S`, `--indent`, `--seq`, `--stream`), error messages and exit statuses, jq's full option set (`--version` reports `jq-1.8.2`), and its grammar and builtins (`?//`, `$__loc__`, modules, `getpath`/`setpath` creating missing paths, `|=` deletions, Oniguruma regexes, dates); it passes jq 1.8.2's own test suite

### Fixed

- Nix builds with `withAppleFm = false` no longer compile the Apple Foundation Models bridge with the host's Xcode ([#18911](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18911))
- Apple Silicon Nix builds include Apple Foundation Models support instead of silently building without it ([#16584](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16584) by [@honsunrise](https://github.com/honsunrise))
- On Windows, the bash tool runs external commands when omp itself runs in an AppContainer sandbox, instead of failing every one with `Permission denied` (exit 126) ([#18800](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18800) by [@devjay4561](https://github.com/devjay4561))
- Explicit Bash prompt rules remain enforced in yolo mode when a command also matches a critical pattern ([#18788](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18788) by [@jasonharrison](https://github.com/jasonharrison)).
- Fixed job widgets and captions failing outright when the `widget` model errors: they now try the role's next model (`retry.fallbackChains.widget`, else the built-in `smol` defaults) and fail only once every candidate has ([#18793](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18793))
- Failed job-widget, job-caption, cache-warm, composer-prediction, and subagent completion-probe calls now keep the provider's error message in their session usage records ([#18792](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18792))
- `/changelog`, `/changelog full`, and `/changelog last N` now list releases newest-first, matching `CHANGELOG.md` and the startup release notes ([#18809](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18809))
- Fixed a `read` placed after a `bash` call in the same message returning the file as it was before that command changed, created or deleted it, in primary and advisor turns ([#16274](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16274) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- RPC/ACP `/session delete` now switches the live session before deleting its file, so later turns save to a new, resumable session ([#18665](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18665)).
- Browser `tab.click`, `tab.dblclick`, `tab.check`, `tab.uncheck`, `tab.uploadFile` and `frame.click` on Chromium tabs now look their selector up again when the page replaces the element before the click goes out, including during and after delivery watcher setup, instead of waiting out the action timeout on the replaced element; a click through an element handle or an `aria-ref` whose element was replaced fails at once ([#18676](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18676) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- A browser `tab.run` whose code uses `document`, `window`, `location` or another page-only global now says the code runs in omp's runtime, not the page, and to use `tab.evaluate`, instead of only "document is not defined" ([#18840](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18840) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- JavaScript eval cells and `tab.run`/`computer.run` strings ending in assignments, blocks, loops, or declarations now return nothing; trailing expressions and explicit returns still produce values ([#18865](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18865) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- A page calling `window.print()` no longer hangs the browser omp launches: `print()` returns at once and `tab.pdf()` still makes PDFs ([#18838](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18838) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `tab.select()` and element-handle `select()` return the options selected after the page's `input` and `change` handlers ran, instead of the choice the page then reset (Chromium tabs) or an option the page's handler had just replaced (cmux and Tern tabs) ([#18829](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18829) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `tab.waitForDownload()` fails, naming the path it looked for, when no file is there on omp's machine, as with a browser reached through `app.cdp_url` on another machine, instead of returning a path that does not exist; such a download is left out of `tab.downloads()` ([#18830](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18830) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- When Chrome detaches omp from a relay tab omp opened and omp cannot reattach, the error now says omp tried to close that tab and to open a new one, instead of telling the agent to navigate it in Chrome; a failed close may be deferred until the relay reconnects ([#18832](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18832) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- A relay `app.target` that matches no tab now recommends omitting `app.target` to open omp's own tab ([#18833](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18833) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Judgments skip a judge candidate for five minutes after it answers 404 for its model, as they already do after a 401/402/403, instead of re-sending the failing request on every judgment of a `find` call ([#18854](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18854))
- Fixed Tern and other OSC 7501 terminals showing a session as `working`, with no needs-you alert, while a dialog waits on you, such as a `ctx.ui.confirm` an extension's `tool_call` handler opens to gate a command: every dialog the TUI shows (extension and hook dialogs, tool approvals, `ask`, `cfg://` changes, the coding-plan reserve confirm, plan review) now reports `blocked` with what it asks until you answer, and a tool approval reports `working` again as soon as you answer it ([#15107](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15107), [#18868](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18868) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))
- The shell's built-in `jq` no longer slows down quadratically on repeated updates such as `reduce range(n) as $i ([]; . + [$i])`
- `/tan` completion notices now quote the user's request and mark the result as the user's tangent, so the main agent no longer mistakes it for its own work
- `omp zsh` with zsh-autosuggestions' `completion` strategy no longer echoes each typed key onto new lines: `vared` inside a `zpty` command now edits on the pty instead of the shell's terminal
- An instruction file that leaves a code fence open has it closed at its end, so the rest of the system prompt is formatted as usual ([#17971](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17971) by [@c-w-z](https://github.com/c-w-z))
- Read-only activity stays visible after snap-compaction or another mid-turn transcript rebuild instead of leaving the UI stuck on “Working…” ([#18876](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18876) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis)).
- With the Spotlight experiment on, a session now warns when Spotlight finds no Stencil credential, once each time the credential goes missing, and says how to sign in again; the `spotlight:shape` journal entry records failed Spotlight calls by cause (`failureCauses`) ([#18850](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18850) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))

### Removed

- Removed `/mcp smithery-search`, `/mcp smithery-login` and `/mcp smithery-logout`; Smithery shut down its API on October 31, 2026 ([#18822](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18822) by [@samettemizer](https://github.com/samettemizer))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- `OMP_APPLEFM_DISABLE=1` builds without the Apple Foundation Models bridge and never probes Xcode or the Command Line Tools; it cannot be combined with `OMP_APPLEFM_SWIFTC` ([#18911](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18911))

### Changed

- The macOS addon's install name is `@rpath/libpi_natives.dylib` instead of the directory it was built in ([#18911](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18911))
- A set `OMP_APPLEFM_SWIFTC` must name a usable Swift 6.4+ compiler with a macOS 27+ SDK: the build now fails instead of falling back to Xcode, the Command Line Tools, or a build without Apple Foundation Models ([#16584](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16584) by [@honsunrise](https://github.com/honsunrise))

### Fixed

- Fixed macOS window screenshots drawing the window smaller than it appears, so clicks aimed from them missed by tens of points; windows spanning displays or partly off screen are captured whole at their on-screen size, except while a sheet larger than the window is open ([#17757](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17757) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed Linux computer reads crashing the app being read (Qt 5 and Qt 6 before 6.9.2 apps anywhere; GTK 3 and Firefox apps on distributions with at-spi2-core before 2.45, such as Ubuntu 22.04), and reading no text from the text fields of newer Qt apps ([#18823](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18823) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS background left clicks crashing the page in Electron apps, and in Chrome when the click changes the URL in place (`history.pushState`, as single-page apps do) ([#18824](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18824) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/omp-stats

### Added

- The Spotlight dashboard's Overhead card breaks failed results down by cause (not signed in, timeout, rate limited, HTTP status, …) and, when results failed for lack of a Stencil sign-in, says how to sign in ([#18850](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18850) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added the Sofya label for `sofya` web search results ([#18185](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18185) by [@yusufgurdogan](https://github.com/yusufgurdogan))
- The context breakdown counts instruction files and skills from the system prompt as built, matching `/context`, and lists Instruction files as its own category ([#17971](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17971) by [@c-w-z](https://github.com/c-w-z))
- Context Viewer adds an Instruction Files category and opens Skills like any other category; `ContextViewEntry.sourceMarkers` colors viewer-only source markers by category in previews and full content, and `ContextViewData.notices` lists snapshot caveats under the Overview legend ([#17971](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17971) by [@c-w-z](https://github.com/c-w-z))

### Fixed

- In Tern, an `ask` question outside a `<fieldset>` gets its own tab instead of sharing the tab of the question before it ([#18660](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18660) by [@DocksDocks](https://github.com/DocksDocks))
- The `/resume` picker shows dates of sessions older than a week in the locale from `LC_ALL`, `LC_TIME` or `LANG` instead of always using `MM/DD/YYYY` ([#18863](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18863) by [@raoulkent](https://github.com/raoulkent))
- Fixed an `ask` HTML form in Tern not taking typing after a click on its Other row or a text well while a composer draft held the keyboard: the click now hands the keys to the form, as ↑/↓ does, instead of every key still editing the draft
- Agent Hub status scopes (All, Running, Done, Parked) show icons in Tern instead of empty squares ([#18880](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18880) by [@a-glapinski](https://github.com/a-glapinski))
- Fixed streaming tables that overflow the screen staying squeezed to their header's column widths after the rows arrive ([#18909](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18909) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))

### Removed

- Removed `estimateSkillsTokens()` and the `skillful` context-usage option; Skills tokens come from the built prompt's sources ([#17971](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17971) by [@c-w-z](https://github.com/c-w-z))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added `prompt.renderTracked`: renders a template like `prompt.render` and reports where each `{{#each}}` iteration over a tracked item lands in the output ([#17971](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17971) by [@c-w-z](https://github.com/c-w-z))
- Added `prompt.closeCodeFence`: closes a code fence a text leaves open, by the same rule `prompt.format` uses ([#17971](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17971) by [@c-w-z](https://github.com/c-w-z))


## What's Changed
* feat(coding-agent): export extension helpers from the package root by @materemias in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18849
* fix(tui): send icons with the Agent Hub status scopes by @a-glapinski in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18880
* fix(tui): keep read-only activity visible after compaction by @JustasMasiulis in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18876
* feat(spotlight): warn on a missing Stencil credential and break failures down by cause by @wolfiesch in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18850
* fix(agent,coding-agent): re-read a file an earlier bash call changed in the same message by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16274
* fix(natives): match macOS window screenshots to the window on screen by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17757
* fix(ai): stop Devin requests from sending temperature 0 by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18461
* fix(tui): give ask questions outside a fieldset their own Tern tab by @DocksDocks in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18660
* fix(session): detached active rpc session before deletion by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18666
* fix(coding-agent): look a click's selector up again when the page replaces its element by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18676
* fix(coding-agent): freeze the per-call model advertisement in the prompt surface by @yuzu-octopus in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18732
* fix(catalog): identify Devin requests as CLI 3000.12.43 by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18766
* fix(bash): preserve explicit prompts over critical patterns by @jasonharrison in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18788
* fix(catalog): drop Devin's retired SWE-1.6 Fast seed row by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18795
* fix(coding-agent): kept errorMessage in side-call usage records by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18796
* fix(pi-shell): create Windows pipes under \\.\pipe\LOCAL\ inside an AppContainer by @devjay4561 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18800
* fix(coding-agent): listed /changelog releases newest-first by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18810
* refactor(coding-agent): remove /mcp smithery-* commands by @samettemizer in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18822
* fix(natives): stop Linux computer reads from crashing Qt, GTK 3 and Firefox apps by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18823
* fix(natives): stop macOS background left clicks from crashing Electron and Chrome pages by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18824
* fix(coding-agent): return the options a page leaves selected after its change handlers by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18829

name: Reasonix Studio v2.61.0
body:
本版是最后一个版本：移除软件内的反馈建议、崩溃报告上传和匿名统计，并修复文件树、提交历史等一批问题。

## 新增

- 工作台的文件树可以拖动边缘调整宽度，宽度会被记住，双击边缘恢复默认 (376376843)
- 新增「进程」按钮，点开列出本会话正在运行的后台任务和子智能体 (3807e411d)
- 新增设置「允许模型直接打开工作区内的文件夹」，默认关闭；打开后模型把本工作区内的文件夹加入项目时不再弹批准卡 #15090

## 修复

- 公式不再被裁掉上标的顶部 #15092
- 没有伪控制台的 Windows 上，终端会说明原因，而不是报"shell 启动失败" #15091
- 在 Cygwin 或 MSYS 终端里运行时，会提示界面无法在这里运行以及该怎么办 #15091
- Windows 上安装前端依赖（pnpm install）不再失败 #15067
- 操作被拒绝时的原因不再被输入框盖住 (f4b815ecd)
- 读取内核失败时，窗口会说明内核无法连接以及是哪一次读取，而不是只显示"Failed to fetch" #15070
- 窄栏里「更改」标题行的按钮换行显示，不再挤成竖排并出现横向滚动条 (a717dcd34)
- 提交历史会在新提交出现、分支变化时自动刷新 (803583e4a)
- 选了资源管理器后，右边不再留着已经打开的启动菜单 (0a17f7774)
- 归档长会话时不再逐个规范化其他会话的路径，归档明显更快 (5cd38fde8)
- Homebrew 安装不再因为 cask 无法读取而失败 #15071
- 构建改用 Go 1.26.11，修复标准库 net/http 的已知漏洞 GO-2026-6859 (75f560400)

## 移除

- 移除软件内的反馈与建议入口、崩溃报告上传和匿名统计；项目不再维护 (21ffa334b)

## 升级须知

- 本版之后项目不再维护。软件不会再向维护者发送任何报告或统计，`reasonix report send` 会被拒绝；更新检查和扩展市场仍会访问原有服务，服务停止后将不可用 (21ffa334b)

---

<!-- lang:en -->

This is the last release: it removes the in-app feedback, crash report upload and anonymous statistics, and fixes a batch of issues in the file tree, commit history and more.

## New

- The workbench file tree can be resized by dragging its edge; the width is remembered and a double click restores the default (376376843)
- A new Processes button opens a list of this session's running background jobs and sub-agents (3807e411d)
- A new setting, "Let the model open folders inside the workspace directly", is off by default; when on, the model adds folders inside this workspace to the project without an approval card #15090

## Fixed

- A display formula no longer loses the top of a raised exponent #15092
- On a Windows without a pseudoconsole, the terminal says so instead of reporting that the shell failed to start #15091
- Run from a Cygwin or MSYS terminal, it says the UI cannot run there and what to do instead #15091
- Installing the frontend dependencies (pnpm install) on Windows no longer fails #15067
- The reason an action was refused is no longer painted over by the composer (f4b815ecd)
- When the kernel cannot be reached, the window says so and names the read, instead of showing only "Failed to fetch" #15070
- In a narrow explorer the Changes header wraps its buttons instead of squeezing into a vertical stack with a horizontal scrollbar (a717dcd34)
- The commit history refreshes when a commit appears or the branch changes (803583e4a)
- Choosing the explorer no longer leaves the start menu beside the tree it just opened (0a17f7774)
- Archiving a long session no longer canonicalizes every other session's path, so it is noticeably faster (5cd38fde8)
- Homebrew installs no longer fail because the cask cannot be read #15071
- Builds now use Go 1.26.11, which fixes the known net/http vulnerability GO-2026-6859 (75f560400)

## Removed

- The in-app feedback and suggestion entry, crash report upload and anonymous statistics are removed; the project is no longer maintained (21ffa334b)

## Upgrade notes

- The project is no longer maintained after this release. The app sends no report or statistic to the maintainers, and `reasonix report send` is refused; update checks and the extension market still use the existing services and will stop working once those are shut down (21ffa334b)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.60.0...studio-v2.61.0


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

body:
### Patch Changes

name: @upstash/context7-sdk@0.7.0
body:
### Minor Changes

- bdd9bf7: `searchLibrary` returns an empty list (or, with `type: "txt"`, a "No libraries found" message) when nothing matches, instead of throwing a 404 `Context7Error`. Text results label the trust score as "Source Reputation", the same as the MCP server.

name: @upstash/context7-mcp@4.7.0
body:
### Minor Changes

- d451493: Add a `page` argument to the `get-upgrade-guide` research preview tool: a long guide now comes in pages, each in full detail. Page 1 starts with everything needed to migrate (summary, before you start, codemods, breaking changes, deprecations), which continues on the next pages when it is longer than one page; behavior, config and API changes follow. A guide is served only once it is complete, so its pages always fit together; until then the tool says it is being prepared and when to call again, or that it could not be prepared.

### Patch Changes

- f2daacb: `get-upgrade-guide` no longer tells the agent never to retry a guide that could not be prepared: the agent uses `query-docs` now and calls again only after the time the answer gives. Telemetry records an unavailable guide as `unavailable` and a page past the last as `invalid`, instead of `not_found`; neither is shown to the agent as an error.

name: v0.5.8 — VoiceStudio
body:
### Download

| Platform | Download | Signing |
|---|---|---|
| Windows x64 | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-win-x64.exe) | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Windows ARM64 (experimental) | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-win-arm64.exe) | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| macOS Apple Silicon | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-mac-arm64.dmg) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| macOS Intel | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-mac-x64.dmg) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| Linux x64 | [AppImage](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-linux-x64.AppImage) · [deb](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-linux-x64.deb) | — Linux packages are not code-signed |
| Android | [APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-android.apk) · [AAB](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-android.aab) | ✅ Signed APK; the AAB is the Play Store bundle |
| iPhone | [Unsigned IPA](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-ios-unsigned.ipa) | ⚠️ Unsigned: sign it with your own Apple ID to sideload; not a TestFlight build |

**Highlights**

- OmniVoice GGUF uses AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs through Vulkan on Windows and Linux, and Intel Arc GPUs run OmniVoice
- Setup falls back to a smaller CPU build when PyTorch downloads fail, and the app falls back to the CPU when the GPU fails
- Windows loads models one file at a time, and an engine crash names its cause and offers Restart on CPU
- dots.tts voice cloning runs on Windows through audio.cpp, with no Python setup
- Convert can keep your delivery and takes video; Dubbing exports subtitles first and moves lines between speakers

**OmniVoice now uses your AMD, Intel or NVIDIA GPU, and VoiceStudio gets much harder to break.** OmniVoice GGUF runs on any Vulkan GPU on Windows and Linux, sizes its model to your card and can stay loaded between requests (opt-in, Settings → Performance), and Intel Arc GPUs run OmniVoice too. When something goes wrong, the app now keeps going: setup offers a much smaller CPU build when the PyTorch download keeps failing, retries stalled downloads, and VoiceStudio moves to the CPU with a notice when the GPU fails. On Windows, models load one file at a time to avoid a crash on first launch, and an engine crash names the library behind it and offers Restart on CPU.

This release also brings dots.tts voice cloning to Windows with no Python setup, Convert that keeps your delivery and takes video, dubbing that exports subtitles first and moves lines between speakers, a `voicestudio` terminal command, background updates, a new macOS installer window, and hundreds of fixes to dubbing, setup, audiobooks and the phone apps.

![The new macOS installer window: drag VoiceStudio to Applications (preview built from the installer's own background and icons)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/main/docs/assets/releases/0.5.8-beta.5-macos-installer.png)

*The new macOS installer window (#4001).*

**Updating from 0.5.7:** Take the in-app update offered by 0.5.7, or install over your existing app; voices, projects and settings are kept. On first launch the local runtime updates its packages in place, including the PyTorch 2.10 security update (#3884)

**Updating from a 0.5.8 beta:** Nothing to do: the Beta channel rolls forward onto 0.5.8 automatically. To stop getting betas, switch to Stable in Settings → Updates → Update channel.

**Running from source:** The Gradio demo and model training are no longer installed by default; add the `ui` or `train` extra if you use them (#4027)

### Changed

- Smaller install: Gradio and WebDataset are no longer installed by default (about 81 MB less); the Gradio demo and model training now use the `ui` and `train` extras (#4027)
- The macOS installer window has a new branded background, larger icons and a clean volume name without the processor suffix (#4001)
- The backend starts lighter and faster: speech-recognition engines are checked in a short-lived helper process instead of being loaded at startup, while broken installs are still reported as unavailable (#3924, #3946)
- The app opens with less code to load: the audio and video players load with the first clip played and returning users skip the first-run setup screens, cutting the startup bundle by about 6%, and a new offline benchmark with a CI check on bundle growth tracks startup, memory, CPU and bundle size (#3924, #3940, #3943)
- Settings → VoiceStudio account lists what to sync and your devices as compact, aligned rows with icons, a Pro badge with one Get Pro link for locked items, and device rows that show OS and when each was last active (#3937)
- The runtime setup screen fits one window: one status line, the install folder with free space, one main action (or the exact fix, such as choosing another folder when the drive is full), with language, region, Python and remote options under Options and recovery tools under More fixes (#3934)
- OmniVoice GGUF can keep its runtime loaded between requests to skip the reload before each generation, as an opt-in under Settings → Performance (#3965, #3654)
- The audio.cpp runtime updates to v0.9.4; installed Breeze-TTS-2, dots.tts and Sortformer models keep working without a re-download, and the previous runtime keeps running them until you install the update (#3129)
- Updates now download in the background and install when you quit, with a compact title-bar pill for progress, Restart and Retry, clearer error messages and a restart prompt when work is running (#3928)
- The top bar is more compact: the account button is just your profile photo, or a person icon when signed out, and the GitHub star count is shortened (#3922)
- Product analytics moved from PostHog to Supermetry, still only after a yes at the first-run prompt, and now also records which engine ran each generation and transcription (#3902)
- Restyled Settings → VoiceStudio account to match the home page: one account card with your plan and storage, the email shown once, and a storage bar visible at 0% (#3885)
- Account sign-in is available in every build, still off until you turn it on, and now starts on the VoiceStudio dashboard with a separate Sign up option (#3850)
- The Pro page in the app now shows the correct $199 Lifetime price (#3831)
- Mac releases use an Apple API key for notarization instead of an account password (#3775) — thanks @velixio!
- Source development now prepares the local API environment before launching Electron (#3637)
- Remove obsolete screenshot and source-archive helpers that targeted the retired UI layout (#3623)
- Removed unused development tools (pytest-cov, Turborepo and a duplicate TypeScript) from the repository and fixed the remaining broken documentation links (#3571, #2603, #2903) — thanks @themrbeasley and @marciok!
- Workflows open at /workflows framed to their steps, Calls opens at /calls, and an unknown address shows Page not found (#3547)
- Projects lists projects under All projects with voices, transcripts, takes and exports grouped under Library; saving a dub now lives in Dubbing (#3547)
- The OmniVoice sidecar availability check no longer imports the model, so backend startup reconcile finishes about 6 s sooner (#3534) — thanks @adrianchen91!
- The first-run install screen is cleaner: one progress bar, a step checklist that shows the package being installed, and Cancel and the log inside the progress card (#3534) — thanks @meisolated!

### Added

- OmniVoice GGUF gets a Self-test in Settings › Models that names the Vulkan GPU it ran on, with docs for older AMD cards such as the RX 5500M (#3993) — thanks @sasankgit!
- Installers now bundle omnivoice.cpp's `tts-server`, so the opt-in OmniVoice GGUF resident mode (Settings → Performance) works in release builds and keeps falling back to the per-request runtime when unavailable (#4005, #3654)
- Qwen Base can deliver audio during generation on the speech WebSocket (#3992) — thanks @kellerkind84!
- OpenAI-compatible PCM speech can stream during synthesis, with native Qwen3-TTS Base support on Apple Silicon and provisioned NVIDIA systems (#3976) — thanks @kellerkind84!
- The account menu in the window corner shows your profile photo, email, plan and cloud storage, with a Manage plan link (#3955)
- The VoiceStudio account card has a larger avatar that opens your profile page to change the photo, an inline display-name editor, a plan badge with icon, an iconized storage meter, and icon buttons for refresh and sign out (#3948)
- Pronunciation dictionaries can now belong to a single voice: switch the pronunciation settings to This voice and its entries win over the language dictionary whenever that voice speaks (#3873)
- New `voicestudio` terminal command: use voices, speech, transcription, dubbing and models from your terminal, with VoiceStudio starting in the background when needed, plus Tab completion (#3828) — thanks @mostafa-ismail-2004!
- An OpenAI-compatible LLM provider with an API key can now use plain HTTP on a trusted LAN IP address, through a new per-provider opt-in that is off by default (#3811)
- Ming-3.0-tts, an opt-in 0.5B voice-cloning engine for Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German and Spanish on NVIDIA GPUs, installs in its own environment from Model Catalogue (#3793)
- Convert voice takes a video: its voice is swapped with Keep my delivery and you get the video back, keeping picture and background when they can be preserved, otherwise the converted audio with a message (#3750)
- Dubbing can now keep the original transcript and speak it in the source language, skipping translation, from the segment menu (#3747)
- Experimental native Windows ROCm setup for RDNA 1 `gfx1010` GPUs (RX 5700 / 5700 XT) runs PyTorch TTS on the GPU, with speech recognition on the CPU (#3734) — thanks @sdf123098!
- Dub video exports can use your graphics card's encoder (NVENC, Quick Sync, AMF, VideoToolbox) as an opt-in, falling back to software if it fails, and a Maximum resolution setting scales large videos down on export (#3732)
- Native Windows ROCm setup supports RDNA 2 RX 6000 GPUs with verified Torch speech, isolated ASR and safer package repair, and installs a hash-pinned HIP CTranslate2 build so faster-whisper transcription runs on the GPU (#3712, #3947) — thanks @dutch2005!
- Tools > Sound effects generates sound effects from a text description with the opt-in MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 engine (NVIDIA GPU, Apache-2.0, desktop and web only; installs only when you click Install) (#3577)
- The Nix flake can now build and run the Linux app with `nix run .`, keeps the NixOS FHS shell, and adds an Apple Silicon dev shell (#2699) — thanks @eaves-dropper!
- Clone and Design now render at each engine's best quality by default, and offer faster settings with a time estimate only when a take is measured to be slow on your computer (#3929)
- Add GUI selection and bounded discovery of existing Python environments with explicit confirmation and consent-gated dependency repair (#3701) — thanks @EriconYu!
- While signed in with account features on, the app sends a periodic check-in with its name, version and operating system; it stops on sign-out or when account features are off (#3892)
- The first-run setup screen shows the detected GPU and whether the install uses Metal, CUDA, ROCm or the CPU build (#3891)
- The first-run setup screen shows the app version and channel, offers a pending update before the runtime download, and keeps install help visible (#3890)
- An available desktop update can be downloaded and installed from a notice on any screen, including first-run setup, and update errors read plainly instead of showing raw server responses (#3881)
- Development cleanup removes project dependencies, environments, build outputs and default app data, with a dry-run preview (#3877)
- Dub, batch dub and Tools → Translate offer Kabyle (Taqbaylit) as a translation target (#3740) — thanks @Aksel103!
- Add per-engine local model folders with authorized discovery, compatibility checks and non-destructive default reset (#3702) — thanks @EriconYu!
- Clone takes can be saved as MP3 as well as WAV from the save button's format menu (#3694) — thanks @lucassmonn!
- Audiobook and Stories scripts take a per-line `[emotion:...]` direction (one line scared, the next excited) on IndexTTS2, CosyVoice 3 and VoxCPM2; other engines and the phone apps skip the tag instead of reading it aloud (#3664) — thanks @sidmax7!
- Settings → Account has a Refresh button that reloads your profile and plan (#3850)
- When the large PyTorch download keeps failing, setup now offers a much smaller CPU version so you still get a working app (#3846)
- VoiceStudio now tests your GPU on startup and uses the CPU, with a notice, if the GPU fails (#3845)
- Crash reports now show what was running and how much memory was free, so out-of-memory crashes are easy to spot (#3844)
- Install and startup failures now name a cause, show the fix first and fill in their own bug report; setup warns about Smart App Control and tests Python before the large download (#3810)
- Add an Arch Linux development source package with package-managed updates (#3771)
- Add Android release updates through Obtainium and a publisher-operated F-Droid repository (#3765)
- Prepare a bundled, signed runtime and persistent folder grants for private Mac App Store validation (#3755)
- Allow explicit external TestFlight beta uploads while keeping internal testing as the default (#3749)
- Let Android and iOS users try models below the recommended RAM, with clear warnings and the existing licence and download checks (#3738)
- Add native Donate, Pro information and Other Apps pages to iOS and Android, with offline artwork and translated copy (#3728)
- Opt-in Settings switch fills [pause] markers and audiobook gaps with the take's own room tone instead of digital silence (#3615, #3611) — thanks @carmoe-prog for the idea!
- OmniVoice GGUF uses AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs through Vulkan on Windows and Linux, sizes its model to the GPU, adds a model quant picker with Download, and offers a one-time Use GPU prompt when PyTorch has no GPU (#3615, #3599) — thanks @dutch2005!
- Galician (Galego) is now available as an app language on desktop and mobile (#3594) — thanks @B1NAR10!
- Supermetry joins as VoiceStudio's first Strategic Sponsor, shown in SPONSORS.md, the README and the in-app Support page (#3583)
- dots.tts now runs on Windows too: the new audio.cpp dots.tts engine clones voices in many languages with no Python setup, and Model Catalogue installs and removes each audio.cpp model on its own (#3574, #2665) — thanks @HuntingSuccubus!
- Convert can now keep your delivery: turn on Keep my delivery to change only the voice while your timing, pauses and intonation stay as recorded (needs CosyVoice 3) (#3573, #3421)
- A transcribed video can be exported before dubbing: subtitles of the edited transcript, or the original video with burned-in subtitles (#3555, #3393) — thanks @EntityinArray!
- Dubbing lines can be moved to another speaker or a new speaker, one at a time or in a selection, and take that speaker's voice (#3555, #3515) — thanks @iamhrhp!
- Audiobook scripts show a live chapter outline: click a `#` heading to jump there, see spoken-word counts, and insert a new chapter from the markup toolbar (#3541) — thanks @mvanhorn!
- Urdu speech reads numbers, years, percentages and decimals in Urdu words instead of raw digits (#3540) — thanks @maatitechnologies-hue!
- Transcribe adds an Identify speakers switch in accurate mode, with speaker labels in segments and exports (#3535) — thanks @adrianchen91!
- Dubbing can jump between flagged transcript segments, including offscreen rows, with Previous and Next issue controls (#3535) — thanks @Thakay!
- Voice Cloning's Emotion button is always on the composer and adapts to the engine — sliders on IndexTTS2, a written direction on CosyVoice 3 and VoxCPM2, and a clear explanation elsewhere; Insert menus gray out tags the engine would read aloud (#3422)
- Nix / NixOS users can build and run VoiceStudio from source with the new community-maintained flake (#2961) — thanks @shamil2!
- Opper is available as a named LLM provider for translation and rewriting, used only after you select it and add a key (#2668) — thanks @Felixkw12!
- API Route is now available as a named LLM provider for translation and rewriting, used only after you select it and add a key (#2596) — thanks @DennyHo0917!

### Docs

- Document experimental Intel Mac Radeon inference and its current integration limits (#4014) — thanks @khawajaJunaid!
- README sponsor credits link strategic sponsors to their repositories, add Spicrawl as a special sponsor, align and space the logos, and direct inquiries to sponsor@voicestudio.sh; the star celebration is removed (#3674, #3717, #3721, #3862, #3975)
- Added an install issue tracker that lists known problems by severity and fix status (#3838)
- The READMEs showcase community video tutorials, including Nafay 3D's (#3735, #3809)
- The README has a compact header with flat badges, the Trendshift badge, Discord, Pro and Cloud links and tidy language links, a larger headline describing VoiceStudio as an AI voice studio for every device, clear download actions and illustrated feature guides (#3653, #3658, #3659, #3660, #3676, #3677, #3691, #3693, #3796, #3797, #3798, #3799, #3800, #3807, #3808)
- Expanded the README to 20 languages with consistent installation commands, guides and language navigation (#3791)
- Celebrated 100,000 GitHub stars and thanked the community in all five READMEs (#3790)
- Organize platform install methods, add Homebrew and keep Docker data on its volume (#3774)
- Add AUR downloads and yay/pacman installation instructions to all READMEs (#3773)
- Remove superseded implementation plans and index current guides, roadmap and retained design references (#3768)
- Feature OpenGTM, Opal and Supermetry as strategic sponsors and introduce their open-source projects in the README (#3687)
- Refresh the README and store screenshots with the default dark theme, a framed feature tour and lighter galleries (#3665)
- README download tables have flat platform icons, group the Snap Store badge with Linux, and fit phone and tablet widths without sideways scrolling (#3661, #3662, #3663)
- The README and Linux install guide link straight to VoiceStudio on the Snap Store (#3649)
- The project structure guide counts the current number of backend service modules (#3610)
- Translated READMEs (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian) follow the new layout (#3604)
- README rewritten: what VoiceStudio is up front, one platform table with downloads and status, a two-command quick start, and a Sponsors section with open slots (#3593)
- Troubleshooting explains why Windows Smart App Control can block engine DLLs even in a signed app, and what you can do about it (#3571, #3209) — thanks @ark2006aug13-byte!
- Install docs say every Apple Silicon Mac is supported, not only M1–M5, and explain the "not supported on this Mac" message from the Intel download (#3557, #3074) — thanks @dahaideweiba!
- New step-by-step guide to dubbing a video with several characters, with a Hindi worked example (#3555, #3424)
- Broken links in the deployment, Linux install and migration guides now open the right page and section (#3534) — thanks @ketpatil77!
- Added a performance baseline with startup, memory and bundle measurements (#3534) — thanks @adrianchen91!
- Install guides list the Snap Store, the Android APK and the sideloaded iPhone IPA (#3518)
- New community-tested guide for running on a Radeon GPU from Windows in a WSL2 distro without Docker: ROCm 7.2.4 + librocdxg, reusable disk images, full build log ([guide](docs/install/wsl-amd-rocm.md)) (#3391)
- Added a Korean README (#3118) — thanks @writer0713!
- The Docker guide explains how to recover from a lost share PIN without deleting saved data or browser credentials (#3006) — thanks @jonathanwxh-cell!
- The Windows install command now uses `irm https://voicestudio.sh/install.ps1 | iex`, so PowerShell always gets the PowerShell installer (#2973, #2982) — thanks @vincentfranstyo!
- Fixed two broken internal links in the competitive analysis and private-API docs (#2903, #2953) — thanks @HyperionBurn!
- The IndexTTS2 link in the expressive-TTS spec now points to the project repository instead of a dead page (#2914) — thanks @amhanesipeace!
- The macOS guide now explains that the "damaged" dialog is Gatekeeper quarantine, not a corrupt download, and gives the Terminal fix first (#2827)
- Added a Russian README (#2778) — thanks @IvanGrigin!

### Fixed

- The invisible watermark no longer adds a faint DC offset to pauses, and the startup warm-up now finds an already-downloaded watermark model (#2818, #4028)
- Windows now loads model weights one at a time by default, so the first launch no longer hits the threaded-loader crash (#3767, #3772, #4024, #4026)
- Intel Arc (XPU) GPUs run OmniVoice as GPU-accelerated instead of reporting a CPU fallback, and load it in bfloat16 instead of float16, which sounded choppy on an Arc 140V (`OMNIVOICE_XPU_DTYPE` overrides it) (#4022) — thanks @mrnitrox!
- CosyVoice 3 GGUF uses your Vulkan GPU again instead of falling back to CPU; its device check misread the runtime's GPU list (#3980, #4009) — thanks @tera-png!
- An Ascend NPU whose extension does not load automatically is detected again; checking for a CPU choice no longer hides it (#4007)
- Restart on CPU after a graphics driver crash no longer loads the GPU driver again, even when a device override was saved in settings (#4006)
- Windows engine crashes now name the fault and the library that crashed, offer Restart on CPU after a graphics driver crash, and load model weights one at a time after a crash in the weight loader (#4002)
- Update MLX to 0.32.4 to address a shutdown crash after Apple Silicon speech generation (#3991) — thanks @kellerkind84!
- Chromium and Electron switches given to the Linux AppImage or .deb reach the app again, and the bundled `voicestudio` command no longer stops macOS and Linux installers from being built (#3996)
- The dubbing error notice links directly to the transcript segment with missing or unreadable speech (#3988) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- Large dubbing stem and segment ZIP downloads no longer hold the entire archive in backend memory (#3986) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- Audiobook chapters and dub segments wait for a speech engine that is briefly busy streaming instead of failing; if it stays busy, the audiobook stops with a clear error and keeps its progress for a retry (#3987)
- Apple Silicon speech requests now retry cleanly when a native Qwen stream is using the MLX model (#3981) — thanks @kellerkind84!
- CosyVoice 3 GGUF now explains why it is unavailable (runtime, model files or device probe) and falls back to the runtime's CPU path when the Vulkan probe fails (#3980)
- Older NVIDIA cards (GTX 900/1000 series) now get an accurate explanation and a pointer to the Vulkan engines instead of advice to install a cu128 PyTorch build (#3978)
- Sizes in Settings, Storage, setup downloads and wheel prefetch move to the next unit instead of showing "1024 KB" or "1024 MB" (#3733, #3972) — thanks @kevin9327!
- Dubbing now tells you which speakers had too little clean speech to clone and use the default voice, and shows transcription warnings such as a missing diarization model (#3419, #3971)
- Dubbing now retries a failed background separation on a lighter setting and then on the CPU, and tells you right away if the original background could not be kept (#3751, #3970)
- Voice cloning decodes non-WAV references for add-on engines and keeps cached source paths relative (#3709, #3958) — thanks @samay-hash!
- Setup now retries a download that hits a temporary server error (such as a 504) and restarts one that gets no data for two minutes, instead of failing or waiting fifteen (#3882, #3950, #3956, #3957) — thanks @velixio!
- Android: a phone voice clone stopped by leaving the app or rotating the phone now says so and keeps the sample and name for Retry (#3953) — thanks @hkarmoush!
- The Nix flake build no longer fails on unrelated changes: its dependency install is built from the package manifests alone and is deterministic (#3949)
- The desktop helper no longer wakes every 8 ms while a dictation shortcut is set, so the installed app stays idle in the background (#3924, #3945)
- Updates no longer leave a second copy of the installed update (about 270 MB) in the updater cache; a downloaded newer update is kept (#3939)
- Sidebar tabs such as Design and Saved no longer cut off to a single letter next to the macOS window buttons (#3926)
- MCP tools now say why VoiceStudio refused a request, such as a model licence to accept, instead of a bare HTTP status, with secrets and home paths removed (#3916) — thanks @meosbrand!
- The Windows uninstaller now offers (default No) to also delete the downloaded runtime and models, keeping your voices and projects (#3911)
- Generate Dub and Batch no longer stop with "Choose a supported language" for Chinese (Simplified) or Chinese (Traditional) on engines that speak Chinese (#3685, #3883) — thanks @victorberinde2-debug!
- The Snap now starts under XWayland by default instead of crashing on native Wayland (set `VOICESTUDIO_SNAP_OZONE_PLATFORM=wayland` to opt back in), and its dictation shortcut helper loads again (#3878, #3879)
- MOSS-TTS-Nano loads and speaks again with transformers 5 (Docker and app installs) instead of failing to load or producing NaN audio (#3851) — thanks @kanakhinyegor-glitch!
- The backend no longer crashes with an illegal instruction on CPUs without AVX2: pedalboard is probed in a separate process first and effects are skipped if it cannot load (#3848)
- Dub now recognizes source languages reported under another spelling, such as Kirghiz, Panjabi, Moroccan Arabic or the old Yiddish code, instead of asking for the language (#3821, #3825) — thanks @Ayushkumarxy!
- Standard Arabic and regional Arabic names now work on engines that list a single Arabic, such as VoxCPM2, instead of failing with "doesn't support language" (#3816, #3817) — thanks @Vivek1898!
- Update checks on a custom or unpackaged build without app-update.yml now say the build cannot self-update instead of failing with a raw ENOENT error (#3814)
