name: v0.5.8-beta.5 — VoiceStudio
body:
### Installer signing

| Platform | Signing |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| macOS (Intel) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| Windows x64 | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Windows ARM64 | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Linux x64 | — Linux packages are not code-signed |

### Phone downloads

Android: [signed APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-android.apk) · [Play bundle](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-android.aab).

iPhone: [unsigned sideload IPA](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-ios-unsigned.ipa). Sign with your own Apple ID to install; this is not a TestFlight build.

**Windows avoids the crash while loading models, Intel Arc GPUs run OmniVoice, and OmniVoice GGUF resident mode now works in release builds.** OmniVoice GGUF runs on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs through Vulkan on Windows and Linux, dots.tts arrives on Windows with no Python setup, and a failing PyTorch download or a broken GPU no longer leaves you without a working app.

**New since beta.4:** Windows loads model weights one at a time by default and names the library behind a crash, and Restart on CPU no longer touches the GPU driver; installers bundle `tts-server`, so OmniVoice GGUF resident mode (Settings → Performance) works; Intel Arc GPUs run OmniVoice in bfloat16; CosyVoice 3 GGUF finds your Vulkan GPU again; the watermark no longer adds a faint offset to silences; Ascend NPUs are detected again; a new macOS installer window; and a default install about 81 MB smaller.

**Testing wanted:** these get their first real-hardware test in this beta, so reports are welcome: OmniVoice GGUF resident mode with the bundled `tts-server`, Intel Arc (XPU) GPUs, Restart on CPU after a graphics driver crash, the new Windows default of loading model weights one at a time, and the new macOS DMG window.

![The new macOS installer window: drag VoiceStudio to Applications (preview built from the installer's own background and icons)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/main/docs/assets/releases/0.5.8-beta.5-macos-installer.png)

**Thanks:** @mrnitrox (Intel Arc support, #4022) and @khawajaJunaid (Intel Mac Radeon docs, #4014) for code; @tera-png (#3980), @Imammahmuda1804 (#3767), @oryx-system (#3772), @pimeNtex (#4024) and @Patrix9999 (#2818) for bug reports.

**Download**

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-win-x64.exe) |
| Windows ARM64 (experimental) | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-win-arm64.exe) |
| macOS Apple Silicon | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| macOS Intel | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-mac-x64.dmg) |
| Linux x64 | [AppImage](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-linux-x64.AppImage) · [deb](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-linux-x64.deb) |
| Android | [APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-android.apk) · [AAB](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-android.aab) |
| iPhone | [Unsigned IPA](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.5/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.5-ios-unsigned.ipa) (sideload with your own Apple ID) |

**Upgrading:** Install over your existing app; voices, projects and settings are kept.

**Highlights**

- OmniVoice GGUF uses AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs through Vulkan on Windows and Linux
- dots.tts voice cloning now runs on Windows through audio.cpp, with no Python setup
- Convert can keep your delivery, changing only the voice
- Dubbing exports subtitles before dubbing and moves lines between speakers
- Setup falls back to the CPU build when PyTorch downloads fail, and the app falls back to the CPU when the GPU fails


### Changed

- Smaller install: Gradio and WebDataset are no longer installed by default (about 81 MB less); the Gradio demo and model training now use the `ui` and `train` extras (#4027)
- The macOS installer window has a new branded background, larger icons and a clean volume name without the processor suffix (#4001)
- The backend starts lighter and faster: speech-recognition engines are checked in a short-lived helper process instead of being loaded at startup, while broken installs are still reported as unavailable (#3924, #3946)
- The app opens with less code to load: the audio and video players load with the first clip played and returning users skip the first-run setup screens, cutting the startup bundle by about 6%, and a new offline benchmark with a CI check on bundle growth tracks startup, memory, CPU and bundle size (#3924, #3940, #3943)
- Settings → VoiceStudio account lists what to sync and your devices as compact, aligned rows with icons, a Pro badge with one Get Pro link for locked items, and device rows that show OS and when each was last active (#3937)
- The runtime setup screen fits one window: one status line, the install folder with free space, one main action (or the exact fix, such as choosing another folder when the drive is full), with language, region, Python and remote options under Options and recovery tools under More fixes (#3934)
- OmniVoice GGUF can keep its runtime loaded between requests to skip the reload before each generation, as an opt-in under Settings → Performance (#3965, #3654)
- The audio.cpp runtime updates to v0.9.4; installed Breeze-TTS-2, dots.tts and Sortformer models keep working without a re-download, and the previous runtime keeps running them until you install the update (#3129)
- Updates now download in the background and install when you quit, with a compact title-bar pill for progress, Restart and Retry, clearer error messages and a restart prompt when work is running (#3928)
- The top bar is more compact: the account button is just your profile photo, or a person icon when signed out, and the GitHub star count is shortened (#3922).
- Product analytics moved from PostHog to Supermetry, still only after a yes at the first-run prompt, and now also records which engine ran each generation and transcription. (#3902)
- Restyled Settings → VoiceStudio account to match the home page: one account card with your plan and storage, the email shown once, and a storage bar visible at 0%. (#3885)
- Account sign-in is available in every build, still off until you turn it on, and now starts on the VoiceStudio dashboard with a separate Sign up option (#3850)
- The Pro page in the app now shows the correct $199 Lifetime price (#3831)
- Mac releases use an Apple API key for notarization instead of an account password. (#3775) — thanks @velixio!
- Source development now prepares the local API environment before launching Electron (#3637)
- Remove obsolete screenshot and source-archive helpers that targeted the retired UI layout. (#3623)
- Removed unused development tools (pytest-cov, Turborepo and a duplicate TypeScript) from the repository and fixed the remaining broken documentation links (#3571, #2603, #2903) — thanks @themrbeasley and @marciok!
- Workflows open at /workflows framed to their steps, Calls opens at /calls, and an unknown address shows Page not found (#3547)
- Projects lists projects under All projects with voices, transcripts, takes and exports grouped under Library; saving a dub now lives in Dubbing (#3547)
- The OmniVoice sidecar availability check no longer imports the model, so backend startup reconcile finishes about 6 s sooner (#3534) — thanks @adrianchen91!
- The first-run install screen is cleaner: one progress bar, a step checklist that shows the package being installed, and Cancel and the log inside the progress card (#3534) — thanks @meisolated!

### Added

- Installers now bundle omnivoice.cpp's `tts-server`, so the opt-in OmniVoice GGUF resident mode (Settings → Performance) works in release builds and keeps falling back to the per-request runtime when unavailable (#4005, #3654)
- Qwen Base can deliver audio during generation on the speech WebSocket (#3992) — thanks @kellerkind84!
- OpenAI-compatible PCM speech can stream during synthesis, with native Qwen3-TTS Base support on Apple Silicon and provisioned NVIDIA systems (#3976) — thanks @kellerkind84!
- The account menu in the window corner shows your profile photo, email, plan and cloud storage, with a Manage plan link (#3955)
- The VoiceStudio account card has a larger avatar that opens your profile page to change the photo, an inline display-name editor, a plan badge with icon, an iconized storage meter, and icon buttons for refresh and sign out (#3948)
- Pronunciation dictionaries can now belong to a single voice: switch the pronunciation settings to This voice and its entries win over the language dictionary whenever that voice speaks (#3873)
- New `voicestudio` terminal command: use voices, speech, transcription, dubbing and models from your terminal, with VoiceStudio starting in the background when needed, plus Tab completion (#3828) — thanks @mostafa-ismail-2004!
- An OpenAI-compatible LLM provider with an API key can now use plain HTTP on a trusted LAN IP address, through a new per-provider opt-in that is off by default (#3811)
- Ming-3.0-tts, an opt-in 0.5B voice-cloning engine for Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German and Spanish on NVIDIA GPUs, installs in its own environment from Model Catalogue (#3793)
- Convert voice takes a video: its voice is swapped with Keep my delivery and you get the video back, keeping picture and background when they can be preserved, otherwise the converted audio with a message (#3750)
- Dubbing can now keep the original transcript and speak it in the source language, skipping translation, from the segment menu (#3747)
- Experimental native Windows ROCm setup for RDNA 1 `gfx1010` GPUs (RX 5700 / 5700 XT) runs PyTorch TTS on the GPU, with speech recognition on the CPU (#3734) — thanks @sdf123098!
- Dub video exports can use your graphics card's encoder (NVENC, Quick Sync, AMF, VideoToolbox) as an opt-in, falling back to software if it fails, and a Maximum resolution setting scales large videos down on export (#3732)
- Native Windows ROCm setup supports RDNA 2 RX 6000 GPUs with verified Torch speech, isolated ASR and safer package repair, and installs a hash-pinned HIP CTranslate2 build so faster-whisper transcription runs on the GPU (#3712, #3947) — thanks @dutch2005!
- Tools > Sound effects generates sound effects from a text description with the opt-in MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 engine (NVIDIA GPU, Apache-2.0, desktop and web only; installs only when you click Install) (#3577)
- The Nix flake can now build and run the Linux app with `nix run .`, keeps the NixOS FHS shell, and adds an Apple Silicon dev shell (#2699) — thanks @eaves-dropper!
- Clone and Design now render at each engine's best quality by default, and offer faster settings with a time estimate only when a take is measured to be slow on your computer (#3929)
- Add GUI selection and bounded discovery of existing Python environments with explicit confirmation and consent-gated dependency repair. (#3701) — thanks @EriconYu!
- While signed in with account features on, the app sends a periodic check-in with its name, version and operating system; it stops on sign-out or when account features are off. (#3892)
- The first-run setup screen shows the detected GPU and whether the install uses Metal, CUDA, ROCm or the CPU build. (#3891)
- The first-run setup screen shows the app version and channel, offers a pending update before the runtime download, and keeps install help visible. (#3890)
- An available desktop update can be downloaded and installed from a notice on any screen, including first-run setup, and update errors read plainly instead of showing raw server responses (#3881)
- Development cleanup removes project dependencies, environments, build outputs and default app data, with a dry-run preview (#3877)
- Dub, batch dub and Tools → Translate offer Kabyle (Taqbaylit) as a translation target (#3740) — thanks @Aksel103!
- Add per-engine local model folders with authorized discovery, compatibility checks and non-destructive default reset. (#3702) — thanks @EriconYu!
- Clone takes can be saved as MP3 as well as WAV from the save button's format menu (#3694) — thanks @lucassmonn!
- Audiobook and Stories scripts take a per-line `[emotion:...]` direction (one line scared, the next excited) on IndexTTS2, CosyVoice 3 and VoxCPM2; other engines and the phone apps skip the tag instead of reading it aloud (#3664) — thanks @sidmax7!
- Settings → Account has a Refresh button that reloads your profile and plan (#3850)
- When the large PyTorch download keeps failing, setup now offers a much smaller CPU version so you still get a working app (#3846)
- VoiceStudio now tests your GPU on startup and uses the CPU, with a notice, if the GPU fails (#3845)
- Crash reports now show what was running and how much memory was free, so out-of-memory crashes are easy to spot (#3844)
- Install and startup failures now name a cause, show the fix first and fill in their own bug report; setup warns about Smart App Control and tests Python before the large download (#3810)
- Add an Arch Linux development source package with package-managed updates (#3771)
- Add Android release updates through Obtainium and a publisher-operated F-Droid repository. (#3765)
- Prepare a bundled, signed runtime and persistent folder grants for private Mac App Store validation. (#3755)
- Allow explicit external TestFlight beta uploads while keeping internal testing as the default. (#3749)
- Let Android and iOS users try models below the recommended RAM, with clear warnings and the existing licence and download checks. (#3738)
- Add native Donate, Pro information and Other Apps pages to iOS and Android, with offline artwork and translated copy. (#3728)
- Opt-in Settings switch fills [pause] markers and audiobook gaps with the take's own room tone instead of digital silence (#3615, #3611) — thanks @carmoe-prog for the idea!
- OmniVoice GGUF uses AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs through Vulkan on Windows and Linux, sizes its model to the GPU, adds a model quant picker with Download, and offers a one-time Use GPU prompt when PyTorch has no GPU (#3615, #3599) — thanks @dutch2005!
- Galician (Galego) is now available as an app language on desktop and mobile (#3594) — thanks @B1NAR10!
- Supermetry joins as VoiceStudio's first Strategic Sponsor, shown in SPONSORS.md, the README and the in-app Support page (#3583)
- dots.tts now runs on Windows too: the new audio.cpp dots.tts engine clones voices in many languages with no Python setup, and Model Catalogue installs and removes each audio.cpp model on its own (#3574, #2665) — thanks @HuntingSuccubus!
- Convert can now keep your delivery: turn on Keep my delivery to change only the voice while your timing, pauses and intonation stay as recorded (needs CosyVoice 3) (#3573, #3421)
- A transcribed video can be exported before dubbing: subtitles of the edited transcript, or the original video with burned-in subtitles (#3555, #3393) — thanks @EntityinArray!
- Dubbing lines can be moved to another speaker or a new speaker, one at a time or in a selection, and take that speaker's voice (#3555, #3515) — thanks @iamhrhp!
- Audiobook scripts show a live chapter outline: click a `#` heading to jump there, see spoken-word counts, and insert a new chapter from the markup toolbar (#3541) — thanks @mvanhorn!
- Urdu speech reads numbers, years, percentages and decimals in Urdu words instead of raw digits (#3540) — thanks @maatitechnologies-hue!
- Transcribe adds an Identify speakers switch in accurate mode, with speaker labels in segments and exports (#3535) — thanks @adrianchen91!
- Dubbing can jump between flagged transcript segments, including offscreen rows, with Previous and Next issue controls (#3535) — thanks @Thakay!
- Voice Cloning's Emotion button is always on the composer and adapts to the engine — sliders on IndexTTS2, a written direction on CosyVoice 3 and VoxCPM2, and a clear explanation elsewhere; Insert menus gray out tags the engine would read aloud (#3422)
- Nix / NixOS users can build and run VoiceStudio from source with the new community-maintained flake (#2961) — thanks @shamil2!
- Opper is available as a named LLM provider for translation and rewriting, used only after you select it and add a key (#2668) — thanks @Felixkw12!
- API Route is now available as a named LLM provider for translation and rewriting, used only after you select it and add a key (#2596) — thanks @DennyHo0917!

### Docs

- Document experimental Intel Mac Radeon inference and its current integration limits (#4014) — thanks @khawajaJunaid!
- Removed the README star celebration and added spacing below the sponsor logos (#3975)
- Updated Spicrawl sponsor links to open its landing page while preserving referral tracking (#3862)
- Added an install issue tracker that lists known problems by severity and fix status (#3838)
- Showcased community video tutorials in the README (#3809)
- Added Pro and Cloud links to README navigation (#3808)
- Polished the README Discord community badges (#3807)
- Added a prominent Discord badge above README platform downloads (#3800)
- Moved the README Discord badge beside the views badge (#3799)
- Highlighted the Discord community and enlarged the README tagline (#3798)
- Simplified the README header text (#3797)
- Compacted the README header and language navigation (#3796)
- Expanded the README to 20 languages with consistent installation commands, guides and language navigation (#3791)
- Celebrated 100,000 GitHub stars and thanked the community in all five READMEs (#3790)
- Organize platform install methods, add Homebrew and keep Docker data on its volume (#3774)
- Add AUR downloads and yay/pacman installation instructions to all READMEs (#3773)
- Remove superseded implementation plans and index current guides, roadmap and retained design references (#3768)
- Link to Nafay 3D's community VoiceStudio video tutorial at the bottom of the English and translated READMEs. (#3735)
- Aligned the special-sponsor logo with the centered README sponsor credits. (#3721)
- Linked strategic-sponsor logos to their GitHub repositories and added Spicrawl as a special sponsor. (#3717)
- Align the README header icon vertically with the VoiceStudio title (#3693)
- Enlarge the README headline, feature summary and device summary with a descending type hierarchy (#3691)
- Feature OpenGTM, Opal and Supermetry as strategic sponsors and introduce their open-source projects in the README (#3687)
- Place language links after the main navigation in all README headers (#3677)
- Move README language links above the title and enlarge the header sponsor logo (#3676)
- Direct README sponsorship inquiries to sponsor@voicestudio.sh (#3674)
- Refresh the README and store screenshots with the default dark theme, a framed feature tour and lighter galleries (#3665)
- Make the README platform comparison fit phone, tablet and desktop widths without sideways scrolling (#3663)
- Add flat rose platform icons to the README download tables (#3662)
- Group the Snap Store badge with Linux downloads under Platforms in the READMEs (#3661)
- List laptops, desktops, servers, phones and tablets in the README device line (#3660)
- Describe VoiceStudio as an AI voice studio in the README headlines (#3659)
- Restore the official Trendshift ranking badge in the README headers (#3658)
- Refresh the README with a compact header, flat badges, clear download actions and illustrated feature guides (#3653)
- The README and Linux install guide link straight to VoiceStudio on the Snap Store (#3649)
- The project structure guide counts the current number of backend service modules (#3610)
- Translated READMEs (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian) follow the new layout (#3604)
- README rewritten: what VoiceStudio is up front, one platform table with downloads and status, a two-command quick start, and a Sponsors section with open slots (#3593)
- Troubleshooting explains why Windows Smart App Control can block engine DLLs even in a signed app, and what you can do about it (#3571, #3209) — thanks @ark2006aug13-byte!
- Install docs say every Apple Silicon Mac is supported, not only M1–M5, and explain the "not supported on this Mac" message from the Intel download (#3557, #3074) — thanks @dahaideweiba!
- New step-by-step guide to dubbing a video with several characters, with a Hindi worked example (#3555, #3424)
- Broken links in the deployment, Linux install and migration guides now open the right page and section (#3534) — thanks @ketpatil77!
- Added a performance baseline with startup, memory and bundle measurements (#3534) — thanks @adrianchen91!
- Install guides list the Snap Store, the Android APK and the sideloaded iPhone IPA (#3518)
- New community-tested guide for running on a Radeon GPU from Windows in a WSL2 distro without Docker: ROCm 7.2.4 + librocdxg, reusable disk images, full build log ([guide](docs/install/wsl-amd-rocm.md)) (#3391)
- Added a Korean README (#3118) — thanks @writer0713!
- The Docker guide explains how to recover from a lost share PIN without deleting saved data or browser credentials (#3006) — thanks @jonathanwxh-cell!
- The Windows install command now uses `irm https://voicestudio.sh/install.ps1 | iex`, so PowerShell always gets the PowerShell installer (#2973, #2982) — thanks @vincentfranstyo!
- Fixed two broken internal links in the competitive analysis and private-API docs (#2903, #2953) — thanks @HyperionBurn!
- The IndexTTS2 link in the expressive-TTS spec now points to the project repository instead of a dead page (#2914) — thanks @amhanesipeace!
- The macOS guide now explains that the "damaged" dialog is Gatekeeper quarantine, not a corrupt download, and gives the Terminal fix first (#2827)
- Added a Russian README (#2778) — thanks @IvanGrigin!

### Fixed

- The invisible watermark no longer adds a faint DC offset to pauses, and the startup warm-up now finds an already-downloaded watermark model (#2818, #4028)
- Windows now loads model weights one at a time by default, so the first launch no longer hits the threaded-loader crash (#3767, #3772, #4024, #4026)
- Intel Arc (XPU) GPUs run OmniVoice as GPU-accelerated instead of reporting a CPU fallback, and load it in bfloat16 instead of float16, which sounded choppy on an Arc 140V (`OMNIVOICE_XPU_DTYPE` overrides it) (#4022) — thanks @mrnitrox!
- CosyVoice 3 GGUF uses your Vulkan GPU again instead of falling back to CPU; its device check misread the runtime's GPU list (#3980, #4009) — thanks @tera-png!
- An Ascend NPU whose extension does not load automatically is detected again; checking for a CPU choice no longer hides it (#4007)
- Restart on CPU after a graphics driver crash no longer loads the GPU driver again, even when a device override was saved in settings (#4006)
- Windows engine crashes now name the fault and the library that crashed, offer Restart on CPU after a graphics driver crash, and load model weights one at a time after a crash in the weight loader (#4002)
- Update MLX to 0.32.4 to address a shutdown crash after Apple Silicon speech generation (#3991) — thanks @kellerkind84!
- Chromium and Electron switches given to the Linux AppImage or .deb reach the app again, and the bundled `voicestudio` command no longer stops macOS and Linux installers from being built (#3996)
- The dubbing error notice links directly to the transcript segment with missing or unreadable speech (#3988) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- Large dubbing stem and segment ZIP downloads no longer hold the entire archive in backend memory (#3986) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- Audiobook chapters and dub segments wait for a speech engine that is briefly busy streaming instead of failing; if it stays busy, the audiobook stops with a clear error and keeps its progress for a retry (#3987)

- The iOS UI smoke suite waits for every screen and control on slow runners and retries a failed test once, so it no longer fails at random (#3982)
- Pull requests wait as drafts with heavy CI skipped until their opener signs the CLA, which now has a 3-day deadline, and a new agent guide helps AI-assisted pull requests arrive merge-ready (#3974)
- The UI crawler waits for lazily loaded code before leaving a screen, and dev servers no longer send /api-reference pages to the backend, fixing a recurring CI flake (#3952)
- CI skips heavy jobs whose exact inputs already passed, and merge-queue runs skip the Electron jobs a change cannot affect (#3933)
- Main-process tests now run on macOS and Windows for every pull request, so platform-specific failures surface before a release (#3927)
- Releases are refused if they carry another channel's update feed, and publishing checks that a beta never becomes the latest release. (#3898)
- CI actions updated: setup-node 7, setup-java 6, deploy-pages 5, CodeQL 4.39.3 everywhere, Vulkan SDK and Docker login actions. (#3893, #3894, #3895, #3896, #3897)
- Release builds retry macOS packaging when Apple's notarization service drops a connection, instead of failing the release. (#3889)
- CI finishes sooner: Python tests run on 6 workers, Electron renderer tests reuse their test environment, and the UI crawler and accessibility smoke wait on real page readiness instead of fixed delays (#3874)
- The iOS keyboard test no longer fails on a slow CI simulator after the keyboard is already gone (#3864) — thanks @velixio!
- Desktop release tag builds no longer stop at startup when they call the phone release workflow (#3860)
- Updated the Vite+ build and test toolchain to 1.5, clearing published dev-server advisories (#3858)
- Read release notes and test fixtures as UTF-8 on Windows (#3766) — thanks @Bl0ck154!
- Refresh the pinned Docker login action used to publish container images (#3761)
- Refresh the pinned checkout action used by CI and release workflows (#3760)
- Refresh the pinned Docker Buildx action used to build container images (#3759)
- Refresh the pinned Python setup action used by CI (#3758)
- Refresh the pinned Gradle setup action used by Android workflows (#3757)
- The iOS on-device speech test no longer fails when the small speech recognizer hears a generated "Hi" as "High" (#3852)
- The CLA comment now links each signer's permanent signature record instead of an older pull request (#3842)
- Pull requests with signed CLAs now get the `cla-signed` label and a comment linking the agreement and signatures automatically (#3840)
- Retry the Android NDK and CMake install in CI when a download comes back corrupt (#3812)
- Publish fork Docker images and registry caches under the repository owner namespace on GHCR (#3795)
- Stabilize iOS UI checks for keyboard dismissal and gallery preset navigation. (#3746)
- Run Apple Silicon smoke checks and native dependency builds on maintained macOS 15 runners. (#3736)
- Reuse the existing iOS archive signing identity and keep camera hardware optional for Android store installs. (#3729)
- Android Play builds prepare native runtimes and verify self-signed upload keys before internal testing (#3725)
- Wait for the iOS keyboard Done control to become hittable before tapping it in smoke tests. (#3646)
- Validate data relocation, engine setup and preset controls together against current main (#3644)
- Disable CodeRabbit finishing-touch repair prompts on pull requests (#3641)
- Stabilize iOS test readiness and cold-build validation, and cover ROCm recovery and batch-language interaction. (#3634)
- Four renderer smoke tests run in CI again after a test-helper move hid them from the smoke inventory (#3600)
- The broken-link check covers CHANGELOG.md and SPONSORS.md, so a rotted link on a repository-root page fails the suite instead of going unnoticed (#3572) — thanks @AliAladraj!
- The Linux GGUF runtime build no longer runs out of memory on CI runners (#3569, #2780)
- Snapcraft Builds can package VoiceStudio from the published release (#3545)
- The iOS Home UI test reliably opens every Home card again instead of flicking cards out of view (#3543)
- The Python test suite no longer aborts on Windows when bun was installed through npm (#3534) — thanks @shubhankarkanase90-byte!
- Pull requests with a changelog fragment pass the changelog check again after a release (#3517)
- Snap Store listing banner, bundled and size-checked with the other Snap listing assets (#3514)
- iOS Home UI tests no longer break when the contributor list is reordered or a card sits under the navigation bar, building on the first fix in #3481 (#3509) — thanks @XiaoPuOuO!
- The Electron unit tests run on Node 25+ and Homebrew Node without extra flags (#3469) — thanks @BichengWang!
- The backend registry test expects the OmniVoice sidecar on Apple Silicon, so it passes on every host (#2697) — thanks @rollroyces!

### Contributors

name: v1.29.1-pre
body:
This week's release includes a Git Panel branch mode that lists every file changed since a base branch, a bookmark picker, configurable Git date formats, support for Claude Fable 5.2 for Anthropic BYOK users (plus Claude Mythos 5.2 if your organization has access), and a setting to turn off automatic agent thread titles.

## Features

### AI

- Added an `agent.auto_generate_thread_titles` setting (default `true`) that can be set to `false` to disable automatic title generation for Zed Agent threads. ([#63998](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63998); thanks [FrederickGeek8](https://github.com/FrederickGeek8))
- Added support for Claude Fable 5.2 for Anthropic BYOK users, plus Claude Mythos 5.2 if your organization has access. ([#66760](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66760))
- Improved the copy button on agent responses to briefly show a checkmark confirming the copy. ([#64664](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64664); thanks [itsfuad](https://github.com/itsfuad))
- Improved the ordering of ACP agent config options in the message editor so the first option the agent provides appears next to the send button. ([#66733](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66733))

### Git

- Added a branch mode to the Git Panel that lists all files changed since a base branch, such as `origin/main`. Choose "Compare Against Base" from the new menu at the top of the Changes tab to pick the base branch, or run `git panel: show branch changes` to compare against the default branch. Files in this mode can be opened as diffs but not staged or restored. ([#66482](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66482))
- Added a `git.date_format` setting (`"locale"`, `"iso"`, or a strftime format such as `"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"`) for absolute Git dates, and `date_style` settings (`"relative"` or `"absolute"`) to choose how dates are shown in each view: `git.blame.date_style`, `git.inline_blame.date_style`, `git.branch_picker.date_style`, `git.stash_picker.date_style`, `git_panel.date_style`, and `git_graph.date_style`. ([#66533](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66533); thanks [scarf005](https://github.com/scarf005))
- Added `git.commit_view.expand_description` and `git.commit_view.expand_files` settings to control whether the commit view opens with the full commit message shown and the changed files expanded. ([#66331](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66331); thanks [mmatczuk](https://github.com/mmatczuk))
- Improved opening a commit from Git blame to scroll the commit view to the blamed file instead of the top of the diff. ([#65237](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65237); thanks [seongheum-choi](https://github.com/seongheum-choi))
- Improved Git status refresh performance in very large repositories when many files change at once. ([#66242](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66242); thanks [ambyjkl](https://github.com/ambyjkl))
- Improved `git: rename branch` to trim the new branch name and replace spaces with dashes, matching branch creation, and to preview the resulting name in the rename modal. ([#65734](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65734); thanks [Sha1rholder](https://github.com/Sha1rholder))
- Improved the Git Panel's repository selector to distinguish repositories that share the same directory name. ([#62800](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/62800); thanks [BirknerAlex](https://github.com/BirknerAlex))

### Other

- Added a bookmark picker for browsing, searching, and previewing all bookmarks in the current workspace, opened with `project bookmarks: toggle`. ([#60005](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/60005); thanks [guopenghui](https://github.com/guopenghui))
- Improved `dev: open key context view` by adding horizontal scrolling, so long context predicates are no longer cut off. ([#66528](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66528))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug where opening a file through the Open dialog (`workspace: open`) replaced the current project with one containing only that file instead of opening it as a tab in the current project. ([#66103](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66103))
- Fixed a bug where switching branches in a remote project resent the full Git history over SSH, stalling the terminal and file opening until the transfer finished. ([#65436](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65436); thanks [azeemshaik025](https://github.com/azeemshaik025))
- Fixed SSH connections failing with "Missing remote shell" when the remote shell's startup reads from stdin. ([#66737](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66737))
- Fixed SSH connections to macOS hosts getting stuck on "Starting Proxy" when the remote server cannot access the system pasteboard. ([#66736](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66736))
- Fixed the file finder not showing files outside the project when searching by absolute path, and files matching `file_scan_exclusions` when searching by their exact path. ([#66227](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66227))
- Fixed a bug where the copy button at the bottom of an agent thread could copy a response from an earlier turn when the latest turn had no response text. ([#64664](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64664); thanks [itsfuad](https://github.com/itsfuad))
- Fixed a bug where the read-only toggle icon and action were shown on tabs that do not support toggling read-only. ([#66650](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66650))
- Fixed animated WebP files only displaying their first frame when opened in the image viewer. ([#66459](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66459); thanks [jorge1b3](https://github.com/jorge1b3))
- Fixed bold text using the wrong theme colors in Markdown previews. ([#63940](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63940); thanks [IbrahimKhan12](https://github.com/IbrahimKhan12))
- Fixed `cmd-o` opening the file dialog instead of project symbol search when using the JetBrains keymap on macOS. ([#66137](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66137); thanks [dmytrodanilenkov](https://github.com/dmytrodanilenkov))
- Fixed combining marks such as `v̄` rendering to the right of their base glyph on Linux. ([#66799](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66799); thanks [ItsGlucose](https://github.com/ItsGlucose))
- Fixed commit messages losing their line breaks in the commit view. ([#66608](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66608); thanks [mmatczuk](https://github.com/mmatczuk))
- Fixed `cmd-k` (macOS) and `ctrl-k` (Linux/Windows) in the JetBrains keymap not focusing the commit message, including when the Git Panel was closed or showing its History tab. Pressing the key again no longer returns focus to the editor; use `cmd-0` (macOS) or `alt-0` (Linux/Windows) to toggle Git Panel focus. ([#66330](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66330); thanks [mmatczuk](https://github.com/mmatczuk))
- Fixed document color inlays multiplying when switching render modes. ([#66732](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66732))
- Fixed entry icons overlapping diff stats in a narrow Git Panel. ([#66278](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66278); thanks [lingyaochu](https://github.com/lingyaochu))
- Fixed extension snippets being duplicated each time an extension is reloaded. ([#66798](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66798); thanks [IbrahimKhan12](https://github.com/IbrahimKhan12))
- Fixed tasks that use file variables such as `$ZED_FILE` not being listed in `task: spawn` when a single file is opened without a folder. ([#66195](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66195); thanks [graduss](https://github.com/graduss))
- Fixed terminal links to absolute paths outside the project not opening when the remote's OS differs from the local one (e.g. WSL on Windows). ([#66594](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66594); thanks [brunocordioli072](https://github.com/brunocordioli072))
- Fixed the end of the Markdown preview being cut off when the file starts with a blank line or an HTML comment. ([#66467](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66467); thanks [yyq1025](https://github.com/yyq1025))
- Fixed the Threads Sidebar not showing a waiting indicator for threads with unanswered agent input forms. ([#66708](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66708); thanks [daejey](https://github.com/daejey))
- Fixed the `zed` CLI rejecting multiple `ssh://` paths on the same host in a single command. ([#66568](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66568); thanks [kawadeomkar](https://github.com/kawadeomkar))
- Fixed Vim `:s` and `:%s` commands not recognizing `\+` and `\{n\}` repetition operators in search patterns. ([#66515](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66515); thanks [akramcodez](https://github.com/akramcodez))
- Fixed which-key closing the commit editor and pickers when a multi-key binding was pending. ([#66630](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66630); thanks [divyanshus2404](https://github.com/divyanshus2404))
- Fixed worktree index corruption when excluding symlinks that point inside a project. ([#64818](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64818); thanks [porada](https://github.com/porada))
- Fixed `zed --add --diff` adding the working directory as a project folder in the focused window. ([#66386](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66386); thanks [abdelq](https://github.com/abdelq))
- Fixed `zed --add` choosing the wrong window or project when several open projects matched equally or none matched, now preferring the focused window and its active project. ([#66386](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66386); thanks [abdelq](https://github.com/abdelq))
- Fixed `Zed.exe path:line` being ignored on Windows when Zed is already running. ([#66501](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66501); thanks [h4nz4](https://github.com/h4nz4))
- Fixed `zed://file` and `file://` links with a drive letter (for example `zed://file/C:/project/main.rs:12`) opening an empty window on Windows. ([#66497](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66497); thanks [h4nz4](https://github.com/h4nz4))

name: v1.28.1
body:
This week's release includes optional automatic Git fetching, a resizable Refs column in the Git Graph, dragging Git Panel files into terminals and editors, and mouse-wheel font zoom in diff views and terminals.

## Features

### AI

- Added an `edit_predictions.button` setting to toggle the edit prediction button in the status bar. ([#66450](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66450); thanks [z0al](https://github.com/z0al))
- Improved compatibility with the latest Agent Client Protocol, including handling of missing sessions, plan updates, diff formats, and cancellation of permission requests. ([#66425](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66425))
- Improved the Agent's `read_file` tool output by truncating lines longer than 2,000 characters to prevent context window overflow. ([#65395](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65395); thanks [Antphar](https://github.com/Antphar))
- Improved subagent cards so that full screen opens a finished subagent run at its start. ([#66252](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66252))

### Git

- Added optional automatic fetching of the current branch's upstream remote and the default branch's remote. Enable it with `git.auto_fetch.enabled`; configure the interval with `git.auto_fetch.interval_secs` (60 seconds by default). Automatic fetching is disabled by default. ([#53089](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/53089); thanks [andriygm](https://github.com/andriygm))
- Added a resizable "Refs" column to the Git Graph that can be toggled on or off from the column header's context menu. ([#66260](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66260); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Added support for dragging files from the Git Panel to the terminal and editor panes. ([#66423](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66423); thanks [mmatczuk](https://github.com/mmatczuk))
- Added support for searching by branch name in the worktree picker. ([#66384](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66384); thanks [michelinux](https://github.com/michelinux))

### Debugger

- Added support for configuring the debugger panel’s default size via `debugger.default_width` and `debugger.default_height`. ([#66435](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66435))

### Languages

- Improved call hierarchy readability by adding spacing between item names and details. ([#66144](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66144); thanks [yskim308](https://github.com/yskim308))

### Linux

- Improved window startup time on Linux with NVIDIA GPUs. ([#66002](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66002); thanks [runsonmypc](https://github.com/runsonmypc))

### Other

- Added support for mouse-wheel font zoom in diff views and terminals with `mouse_wheel_zoom` enabled: `cmd-scroll` on macOS and `ctrl-scroll` on Linux/Windows. ([#66296](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66296); thanks [ndri](https://github.com/ndri))
- Improved responsiveness when navigating code, loading completion details, and comparing files. ([#66487](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66487))
- Improved the reliability of language server and agent downloads with consistent checksum verification, rejection of failed HTTP responses, and better cleanup of partial downloads. ([#66048](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66048))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug where launching Zed on Windows while it was already running prevented the previous session from being restored. ([#66364](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66364); thanks [somtri](https://github.com/somtri))
- Fixed Agent context compaction unnecessarily using uncached input tokens with supported providers, including OpenAI and xAI. ([#64938](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64938); thanks [tidely](https://github.com/tidely))
- Fixed auto-compaction only running once during a long agent turn, which could let the thread exceed the model's context window. ([#66215](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66215))
- Fixed compaction not reusing the prompt cache for ChatGPT subscription models. ([#66527](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66527))
- Fixed creating pull requests from Zed for Forgejo remotes, including Codeberg. ([#66182](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66182); thanks [Lachstec](https://github.com/Lachstec))
- Fixed external agents sometimes starting without MCP servers configured in user settings when the thread was created before the project folder finished loading. ([#64612](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64612); thanks [philwinder](https://github.com/philwinder))
- Fixed Helix mode operations overwriting the system clipboard when `vim.use_system_clipboard` was set to `"always"`. ([#55455](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/55455); thanks [SrGaabriel](https://github.com/SrGaabriel))
- Fixed local files opening as empty buffers in remote workspaces. ([#65771](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65771); thanks [Huliiiiii](https://github.com/Huliiiiii))
- Fixed mentioning, sharing, and deleting project skills in remote workspaces. ([#66207](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66207))
- Fixed Project Search buttons affecting the wrong pane when clicked in an unfocused split. ([#50882](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/50882); thanks [transitoryangel](https://github.com/transitoryangel))
- Fixed registry agents installed via npm (such as Claude Agent) failing to launch with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` after an interrupted or concurrent install. ([#66235](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66235))
- Fixed remote terminals and tasks failing on Windows SSH servers whose default shell is Nushell. ([#65580](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65580); thanks [lingyaochu](https://github.com/lingyaochu))
- Fixed remote workspaces sharing a directory being merged into one workspace after restarting Zed. ([#66289](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66289); thanks [buvidk1234](https://github.com/buvidk1234))
- Fixed SSH connections failing with "Missing remote shell" when the remote shell's startup reads from stdin. ([#66737](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66737))
- Fixed SSH connections to macOS hosts getting stuck on "Starting Proxy" when the remote server cannot access the system pasteboard. ([#66736](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66736))
- Fixed stale language server data being shown in multibuffers. ([#66264](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66264))
- Fixed SVG images failing to render in Markdown previews for remote projects. ([#66404](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66404); thanks [max1ab](https://github.com/max1ab))
- Fixed synthetic mouse movements on Windows repositioning the editor cursor when the window repainted, such as when opening the command palette. ([#55739](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/55739); thanks [khaledtf19](https://github.com/khaledtf19))
- Fixed the Git Panel showing “No Git Repositories” after removing the active repository’s project folder from a remote workspace while other repositories remained open. ([#66299](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66299); thanks [buvidk1234](https://github.com/buvidk1234))
- Fixed the global busy cursor lingering after Zed opened on GNOME Wayland. ([#64058](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64058); thanks [eukreign](https://github.com/eukreign))
- Fixed the skill creator saving project skills to the local machine instead of the remote in remote workspaces. ([#66224](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66224))
- Fixed wide submenus and popovers covering the menu or button they open from. ([#66496](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66496))
- Fixed worktree task hooks running when a workspace was in restricted mode. ([#66284](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66284))
- Fixed a bug where document color inlays were duplicated when switching the `lsp_document_colors` setting between `inlay` and `border` or `background`. ([#66732](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66732))
- Fixed a missing scrollbar in the Open Remote picker, making additional remote servers easier to discover. ([#63909](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63909))
- Fixed AI features and edit predictions continuing to use an organization after you were removed from it. ([#66494](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66494))
- Fixed an issue where using `pane: reveal in project panel` after closing the last terminal tab would unexpectedly reopen the terminal panel. ([#66472](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66472))
- Fixed author names and avatars being vertically misaligned in the Git Graph. ([#66187](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66187); thanks [albertbogusz](https://github.com/albertbogusz))
- Fixed call hierarchy hover tooltips not showing full details, including package paths, when rows were truncated. ([#66144](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66144); thanks [yskim308](https://github.com/yskim308))
- Fixed false missing-property warnings for CodeLLDB debug configurations using build-based target inference. ([#64133](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64133); thanks [ZhehooMorgen](https://github.com/ZhehooMorgen))
- Fixed images in the Markdown preview being rendered with rounded corners. ([#65474](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65474); thanks [OmChillure](https://github.com/OmChillure))
- Fixed missing syntax highlighting for C++ lambda specifiers and the `defined` preprocessor operator. ([#66406](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66406); thanks [riddhigupta1110](https://github.com/riddhigupta1110))
- Fixed Remote Projects rejecting SSH commands whose `ssh` executable was shell-quoted. ([#66360](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66360); thanks [zozo123](https://github.com/zozo123))
- Fixed square corners showing on terminal tool cards in the Agent Panel with themes whose element background differed from the panel background. ([#66367](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66367); thanks [fuzzcan](https://github.com/fuzzcan))
- Fixed tasks that use file variables such as `$ZED_FILE` not being listed in `task: spawn` when a single file is opened without a folder. ([#66195](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66195); thanks [graduss](https://github.com/graduss))
- Fixed the History tab in the Git Panel losing the highlight on the open commit when clicking into the commit view. ([#66226](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66226))
- Fixed Windows shell detection for executable names containing uppercase letters. ([#66387](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66387); thanks [M0-kii](https://github.com/M0-kii))

name: Voyager v2.3.2
body:
> _"Magic is a world of visual imagination." — Frieren, 《Frieren: Beyond Journey's End》 (2023)_ ## ✨ What's New | Feature | Description | By | | --- | --- | --- | | **Create mode** | Say in one sentence how you want a site to change; the site's AI writes a small plugin, and Voyager reviews it with you and installs it. Open the panel with Alt/⌥+V and pick **Create**. [Docs](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/create-mode) | — | | **Recolor Voyager** | A creation can recolor Voyager's own panels, menus and timeline through public `--gv-theme-*` variables. The built-in Nord palette (off by default) was made this way: its first version was written by Gemini (Argon) in Create mode. (closes #821) | — | | **Creations that run code** _(off by default)_ | For what a style change cannot do, the AI can write a script. You see the full source first and turn on Chrome's user scripts switch yourself. Desktop Chrome and Edge only. | — | | **Show the AI the page** | A request can carry the structure of the current page, with none of its text, previewed before sending. Gemini warns when the selected model usually cannot write a plugin. | — | | **Fix it when it goes wrong** | A reply that cannot install says why, an installed creation that changes nothing is flagged, and both offer **Ask it to fix**. | — | | **No refresh after an update** | Open tabs pick up the new version on their own; a tab that cannot shows a card and reloads only on a click. | — | | **Update reminders** | Choose between opening the release notes, a NEW mark on the floating ball, or nothing; notes for skipped versions are shown together. | — | | **Font size in 1% steps** | Reading font size takes a typed number and resets to 100%. | PR #1086 by @eacheat53 | ## 🐛 Bug Fixes | Fix | Description | By | | --- | --- | --- | | **ChatGPT export** | Very long conversations export in full, and the export button no longer jumps while the page loads. (closes #1071) | — | | **ChatGPT timeline** | Each run in a scheduled task conversation gets its own marker. (closes #1091) | — | | **ChatGPT Vim mode** | The mode badge stays beside the composer, on Codex too. | — | | **Gemini sidebar** | With auto-hide on, opening the account switcher no longer collapses the sidebar. | — | | **Theme** | Until a theme is picked, Voyager follows the system's light or dark. | PR #1085 by @eacheat53 | | **Touch** | A finger can drag the floating ball and reach **Hide**. (closes #1089) | — | | **Update reminders** | Badge mode marks the next release as it should. | — | --- ## 中文版 > _「魔法是想象的世界。」——芙莉莲，《葬送的芙莉莲》（2023）_ ## ✨ 新功能 | 功能 | 说明 | 提交者 | | --- | --- | --- | | **创造模式** | 用一句话说想让网站变成什么样，网站上的 AI 写一个小插件，Voyager 跟你一起检查后装上。按 Alt/⌥+V 打开面板，点「创造」。[文档](https://voyager.nagi.fun/guide/create-mode) | — | | **给 Voyager 换配色** | 创造可以通过公开的 `--gv-theme-*` 变量改 Voyager 自己的面板、菜单和时间轴颜色。内置的 Nord 配色（默认关闭）就是这么来的：第一版由 Gemini（Argon 模型）在创造模式里写出。（关联 #821） | — | | **会运行代码的创造** _（默认关闭）_ | 只改样式做不到的事，可以让 AI 写脚本。安装前能看到全部代码，浏览器的用户脚本开关要你亲手打开。只支持电脑上的 Chrome 和 Edge。 | — | | **让 AI 看清页面** | 请求可以附上当前页面的结构，不含任何文字，发送前可预览。Gemini 上选了通常写不出插件的模型时会提醒。 | — | | **出问题能修** | 装不了的回复会说明原因，装上却没效果的创造会被标出来，两种都可以点「让它修复」。 | — | | **更新后不用刷新** | 已打开的标签页自动换上新版；换不上的出现一张卡片，点了才刷新。 | — | | **更新提醒** | 可选弹出更新说明、悬浮球标 NEW 或不提醒；跳过的版本说明会一起显示。 | — | | **字号按 1% 调整** | 阅读字号可直接输入数字，一键回到 100%。 | PR #1086 by @eacheat53 | ## 🐛 修复 | 修复 | 说明 | 提交者 | | --- | --- | --- | | **ChatGPT 导出** | 很长的对话能完整导出，页面加载时导出按钮不再跳动。（关联 #1071） | — | | **ChatGPT 时间线** | 定时任务对话里每次运行都有自己的标记。（关联 #1091） | — | | **ChatGPT Vim 模式** | 模式标记留在输入框旁边，Codex 上也一样。 | — | | **Gemini 侧边栏** | 开着自动隐藏时，打开账号切换面板不再把侧边栏收起来。 | — | | **主题** | 没选过主题时一直跟随系统深浅色。 | PR #1085 by @eacheat53 | | **触屏** | 手指可以拖动悬浮球，也点得到「隐藏」。（关联 #1089） | — | | **更新提醒** | 选了只标 NEW 后，下次更新能正常标出。 | — | --- **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager/compare/v2.3.1...v2.3.2 ## 📥 Installation
     

Edge users: Voyager is still maintained on Edge Add-ons for users who need Edge on mobile or tablet. If review is delayed, Chrome Web Store and GitHub manual packages remain available.

- **Chrome / Edge / Chromium browsers**: `voyager-chrome-v2.3.2.zip` - **Firefox**: `voyager-firefox-v2.3.2.xpi` - **Safari**: `voyager-v2.3.2.dmg` > Do not use GitHub's auto-generated **Source code (zip/tar.gz)** archives for manual extension installs. Those files are repository source snapshots, not browser-ready extension packages.
🍎 Safari 安装与升级说明 (Safari installation & upgrade) > 🎉 从 v1.6.0 起，Voyager 的核心功能已正式覆盖 Safari。 > Starting with v1.6.0, Voyager's core experience is officially supported on Safari. - 📦 **安装 (Installation)**: 下载并打开 `voyager-v2.3.2.dmg`，按提示安装应用。 Download and open `voyager-v2.3.2.dmg`, then follow the prompts to install the app. - ⚠️ **旧版升级 (Legacy upgrade)**: 如果仍安装着 `Gemini Voyager.app`，请先完成一次 [Safari 迁移步骤](https://voyager.nagi.fun/guide/safari-migration)，避免两个 App 并存。 If `Gemini Voyager.app` is still installed, follow the one-time [Safari migration guide](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/safari-migration) first so the two apps do not conflict. - 🖼️ **图片能力 (Images)**: Image Refinement 水印去除、全尺寸图片下载与聊天导出中的图片提取均已支持。 Image Refinement watermark removal, full-size image downloads, and image extraction in conversation exports are supported. - ☁️ **原生云同步 (Native cloud sync)**: Google Drive 与 iCloud 同步均已接入 Safari 原生层。 Google Drive and iCloud sync are integrated through Safari's native layer. - 🔔 **系统通知 (Notifications)**: Gemini 回复完成后可发送 macOS 通知，并直达对应对话。 macOS can notify you when a Gemini response finishes and open the matching conversation. - 🔄 **自动更新 (Automatic updates)**: 完成这次迁移后，后续版本可通过 Sparkle 自动更新。 After this one-time migration, future versions can update automatically through Sparkle.

name: openclaw 2026.11.5-beta.2
body:
## 2026.11.5-beta.2

### Highlights

- Large conversations remain browsable with paged history in both directions, visible history boundaries, and bounded archive reads. (#188450 #188483 #188557 #188372 #190690) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @xydt-tanshanshan.
- The macOS app preserves saved secrets and Gateway authentication when configuration saves fail or Tailscale exposure is turned off. (#187734 #187664; related #187600, #187597) Thanks @anmol0b.
- Ending Talk on Android no longer cancels work the Gateway has already accepted. (#188798; related #188134) Thanks @RomneyDa and @jeffjhunter.

### Changes

- Google: use the Interactions API for Gemini Flash models on the official endpoint while retaining custom endpoint overrides. (#189395) Thanks @obviyus.

### Fixes

- Security: reject malformed URI identifiers using fast-uri 4.2.3 while preserving valid relative references. (#187284) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
- Security: reject oversized bounded collections early in the Discord SDK and its transitive Zod 3 parser without restoring the retired A2UI integration. (#187296 #187303) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
- Message delivery: acknowledge retried committed input without starting duplicate turns, retain queued messages during inline edits, and keep Control UI plugin-reload replies from leaking into the last external chat. (#188527 #189869 #190982; related #189845, #190980) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @shakkernerd, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
- Chat recovery: preserve completed reasoning, refill chat snapshots, retain active-request provenance through compaction, and resume configured fallbacks after interrupted attempts. (#188203 #180214 #188672; related #188181) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @shakkernerd and @RomneyDa.
- Sessions: bound listing, imported-history, and accounting reads without blocking writers; omit misleading continuation metadata from centered history. (#189284 #190182 #188612) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
- PostgreSQL: keep session search on its text index across repeated searches, use a safe iMessage recovery cursor, and allow Boards widgets to publish. (#187909 #188979 #184919 #189564; related #187908, #188954, #184862) Thanks @etzelm, @obviyus, and @galiniliev.
- Files: preserve the identity of Unicode keys when reading and editing workspace paths. (#189868; related #189866) Thanks @Malpin07 and @obviyus.
- File transfer: avoid first-turn workspace-memory and skills import races when plugins load from TypeScript source. (#191838) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Agents: keep subagent turns and model fallback aligned with changed session capabilities, and surface child approval requests to parents using custom session stores. (#179312 #183501 #189827; related #179290, #189823) Thanks @chelsealong, @obviyus, @Marvinthebored, @RomneyDa, and @ekinnee.
- Tool outcomes: retain timeout results so interrupted tools are not mistaken for confirmed failures without side effects. (#180247) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Matrix: start new thread sessions without copying the room transcript; report readiness only after startup, let stopped CLI clients exit, and report late verification failures rather than crashing. (#177272 #192385; related #176224) Thanks @Linux2010, @obviyus, @seriouslysean, and @RomneyDa.
- Google: honor configured topP and restore tool calls whose parameter names are Python keywords. (#190695 #191561; related #190468) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Yigtwxx, @obviyus, @yetval, and @HighervGround.
- Anthropic: keep setup-token credentials separate from API-key profiles, set the API workspace at login, and allow reasoning-only retries. (#187875 #186976 #184434; related #187868, #187018, #182178) Thanks @RomneyDa, @sasan1200, @sukhdeepjohar, and @goslingmanagment.

(#128175 #191468 #187000; related #128171) Thanks @TheAngryPit, @CassieMei, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @anmol0b.

(#185432 #186271 #190729 #172116) Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, @anmol0b, @holgergruenhagen, and @LiuwqGit.

- macOS service runtime ownership: prepare and retain the stable executable across install, resume, migration, and service restoration without replacing a newer runtime during failed settlement. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Release recovery: retain publication retry diagnostics and preserve the reconciled release repairs. (#189130 #191633) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.

name: CC Switch v4.0.30
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.30

本版本新增**隐私过滤器**：在路由和聚合模式下，本地路由转发请求前可以把用户输入和系统提示里的个人信息和密钥替换成占位符，不让它们发到上游。默认关闭，开关在「设置 → 数据」。

另外修复了 Codex 经路由连第三方原生 Responses 上游时，请求带上只有 OpenAI 认的字段被整条拒绝（报 400）；工具调用参数里出现重复的键后，Codex 对话每一轮都报 400；Windows 上主窗口打开在任务栏下面、按钮点不到；Antigravity 免费账号查额度报 403、锁区账号看不出原因；Antigravity 用量同步每分钟重读全部会话占满 CPU 等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.30-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.30-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### 隐私过滤器

开启后，本地路由在转发请求前，会把用户输入和系统提示中的个人信息和密钥替换为 `[邮箱]`、`[密钥]` 这样的占位符（[#8951](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8951)）。开关在「设置 → 数据 → 隐私过滤器」，默认关闭。

- **会替换什么**：邮箱、中国大陆手机号、身份证号、银行卡号、IPv4 地址（127.0.0.1 这类回环地址除外），以及 API Key、Token、私钥、「密码是…」「api_key=…」这类口令。
- **不会动什么**：模型回复、思考内容、工具调用参数和图片。
- **工具结果**（文件内容、命令输出等）默认不处理，可以用「同时过滤工具结果」子开关打开。打开后模型只能看到占位符，改文件时可能因为对不上原文而失败，整文件重写时占位符可能被写回你的文件，请确认能接受再开。
- 只在路由和聚合模式下生效。直连模式下请求不经过 CC Switch，不会被过滤。
- 完全在本机按规则匹配，不调用任何模型；替换不可逆，占位符跟随界面语言（韩语、俄语界面暂用英文占位符）。规则移植自 [packyme/privacy-filter](https://github.com/packyme/privacy-filter)。

### 新模型价格

- 内置 Claude Fable 5.2（[#9426](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9426)）和 Gemini 4 Carbon（[#9421](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9421)，按截至 11 月 30 日的介绍价）的价格，用量统计里不再显示「未定价」。已经自己填过价格的不会被覆盖。

---

## 变更

- **打开供应商编辑页更快**（[#9357](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9357)）：以前重启后第一次点编辑要等 1~2 秒，供应商多时打开、关闭编辑页也会卡一下，在名称框打字也不够跟手。现在启动后会在空闲时预先加载编辑页，打开、关闭和输入都不再拖慢整个列表。
- **Codex OAuth 卡片显示账号**（[#9300](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9300)）：Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop 里的 Codex OAuth 供应商卡片，副标题从 ChatGPT 价格页网址改为「账号 · 套餐」，和其他官方账号卡片一致。
- **Copilot 官方登录卡片并入「已添加」**：不再单独占一组，排在已添加供应商的第一个。
- **手动改过 `SKILL.md` 后，Skills 页面的名称和描述会更新**（[#9316](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9316)，相关 [#7848](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7848)）：在后台检查，不再在打开 Skills 页面、切换开关时扫描全部技能目录。

---

## 修复

- **Codex 经路由连第三方原生 Responses 上游时，请求被整条拒绝，报 400**（[#9042](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9042)、[#9077](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9077)）。v4.0.28 起，有 ChatGPT 登录时第三方路由也写成 Codex 内置的 `openai`，Codex 因此会带上只有 OpenAI 自己认的字段，LM Studio、LiteLLM 和部分中转这类校验严格的上游会拒绝整个请求。现在发往第三方时按 Codex 自己对非 OpenAI 上游的处理把这些字段都去掉；官方卡和授权中心的 ChatGPT 账号不受影响。
- **工具调用参数里出现重复的键后，Codex 对话每一轮都报 400，再也继续不了**（[#9339](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9339)、[#9341](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9341)）。模型偶尔会在一次工具调用里把同一个参数写两遍，Codex 每一轮都会把历史原样再发一遍，校验严格的上游就一直拒绝。现在发往第三方原生 Responses 上游前，重复的键只保留最后一个；官方不受影响。
- **Windows 上主窗口打开时被任务栏挡住下半截，更新弹窗的按钮点不到，重启也一样**（[#9206](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9206)、[#9336](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9336)）。现在启动时会把窗口挪回屏幕可用区域内，太大就缩小；macOS 上被程序坞挡住同理。
- **Antigravity 免费账号查额度报「403 You do not have a valid license of this product」；锁区账号在授权中心照常显示额度，看不出为什么登录不了**（[#9413](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9413)、[#9414](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9414)）。现在查额度的方式与 `agy` 一致；Google 判定账号不可用（例如地区不支持）时，显示 Google 给出的原因。
- **`agy` 升级到 1.5 后，授权中心认不出正在用的 Antigravity 账号；切换账号后，没绑定账号的 Antigravity 官方卡片显示的还是上一个号的额度**（[#9318](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9318)、[#9320](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9320)）。
- **Antigravity 会话多时，CC Switch 在后台持续占满一个 CPU 核、大量读盘**（[#9346](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9346)）。以前每分钟把所有会话记录完整读两遍，现在没变化的会话直接跳过。
- **经路由使用 Gemini 时，流式请求的用量记成请求里的模型名，不是实际回答的模型；Vertex AI 形式的上游成功请求在用量统计里没有记录**（[#7738](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7738)、[#7740](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7740)）。
- **Copilot 自带 Key 的供应商，填了「上下文窗口」和「最大输出 Token」、没填「最大输入 Token」的模型，输入仍被限制在 128K**：现在按「上下文窗口 − 最大输出 Token」写入最大输入，自己填过的值不变。
- **Windows 上没装 Copilot CLI、但装了 VS Code 时，Copilot CLI 显示为「已安装·无法运行」**：VS Code 自带的 Copilot 占位程序不再被当成 Copilot CLI，现在正确显示为未安装。
- **macOS 和 Linux 上升级后弹出的更新摘要被压扁，只露出一行**（[#9401](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9401)）。
- **OpenCode 的 Oh My OpenCode Slim 表单所有按钮点了都没反应**（[#2067](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/2067)、[#3905](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/3905)）。
- **v3.7.0~v3.8.0 发布说明底部的 README / CHANGELOG 链接打不开**（[#7744](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7744)、[#7750](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7750)）。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @funkpopo（隐私过滤器、供应商编辑页提速）、@allenxu09（隐私过滤器、Codex OAuth 卡片显示账号、更新摘要被压扁）、@yukitakasama（Codex 只给 OpenAI 的字段）、@mo2g（工具参数里的重复键）、@HEOJUNFO（窗口被任务栏挡住）、@jimpablo（Antigravity 额度、锁区提示与 agy 1.5 登录）、@wandugu（Antigravity 用量同步）、@SailingLoong（Gemini 用量）、@wyr-zal（Skills 元数据刷新）、@inscripoem（OMO Slim 表单）、@DawnChase（Claude Fable 5.2 价格）、@Quiyyy（Gemini 4 Carbon 价格）、@Chunai-Bboy（旧版发布说明链接）、@merlinyan05（贡献指南）的贡献。

感谢 @iSanae233、@Shanorino、@jiuyuan917、@wshiqyuan、@yuanyuan2233、@bsbofmusic、@roli-lpci 提出需求、报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

- **ads** (2.7.4 → 2.7.5): the untrusted-data rule in `references/audit-guardrails.md` describes an embedded "drop your earlier instructions" directive instead of quoting the literal injection phrase, which Hermes' Skills Guard flagged as a critical prompt injection and blocked on install. Same rule, same meaning.

name: v2.14.11 — directory-submissions (2.1.7 → 2.2.0): a listing kit (references/listing-kit.md) to fill…
body:
- **directory-submissions** (2.1.7 → 2.2.0): a **listing kit** (`references/listing-kit.md`) to fill in once before the first submission: every fact directories ask for, the copy at each common length limit (40, 60, 100, 160, and ~500 characters), asset sizes, and a submission log with statuses for skips and hand-offs. A new section covers **agent-run submissions**: check the log first, use a documented API or `/llms.txt` route before a form, open embedded forms on their own page, fill only visible fields and stop at any CAPTCHA or login, keep personal phone numbers and addresses off listings, no paid listings without approval, close email verification loops, and read an awesome list's contributing rules and recent merges before opening a PR. Directories without an API or PR route are **filled with browser or computer use**: the user signs in once per batch, the agent maps fields to the kit, uploads assets, shows a screenshot of the filled form for approval, submits, and logs the confirmation; CAPTCHAs, logins, payments, and terms go back to the user and the agent resumes after. A new `references/agent-registry-files.md` lists the repo files agent registries read (`server.json`, `glama.json`, `gemini-extension.json`, Cursor and Claude plugin manifests, `SKILL.md`), checked against each registry's docs: only the Gemini CLI gallery lists a repo from the file alone; skills.sh lists from install counts; the rest need a claim or a reviewed submission. Prompted by Ilias Ism's directory-submissions skill.

name: pandoc 3.14
body:
I'm pleased to announce the release of pandoc 3.14,
available in the usual places:

Binary packages & changelog:
https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/releases/tag/3.14

Source & API documentation:
http://hackage.haskell.org/package/pandoc-3.14

This release includes a lot of bug fixes and small improvements,
including improvements in dependencies, which you can read about
in the changelog. Here are the changes of special note:

- Pandoc now searches a path given in an enviornment variable
  PANDOC_DATA_DIRS when looking up data files (including
  templates, filters, defaults files, metadata files, etc.).
  The user data directory is still tried first. This change
  will make it easier to create distributions of pandoc with
  special customized data files.

- The LaTeX writer now uses custom macros for footnotes in
  tables and definition lists, fixing a bug with hyperlinks
  in the notes in these contexts. Those who use custom templates
  will need to import the definitions of these macros from
  the default LaTeX template.

API change:

- Text.Pandoc.Class exports new functions `getDataDirs`
  and `getPandocDataDirs`.

Thanks to all who contributed, especially new contributors
Alain Lesage, Asuka, Caio Vinícius, Jeremy Levartovsky,
Nacho García, tyler000000.

<details>
  <summary>Click to expand changelog</summary>

- Support `PANDOC_DATA_DIRS` for data file lookup (#7922). If `PANDOC_DATA_DIRS` is set, the (absolute) directories it lists are searched, in order, for data files not found in the user data directory, before falling back to the default data files. This covers templates, filters, defaults files, metadata files, CSL styles, and other data files. If `PANDOC_DATA_DIRS` is set, print its value in `--version` output.

- Reset sourcepos when parsing footnotes and grid table cells (#12001, extends fix for #11888). Otherwise, when one of these ends a file, relative paths in it can be rebased against the next file on the command line.

- LaTeX reader:

  - Fix duplicated text after a control space at line end (#12051, Asuka).
  - Handle pandoc’s deferred footnotes (`\pandocfootnotemark{n}` and `\pandocfootnotetext{n}{..}`) as produced by the LaTeX writer for notes in tables, captions, etc.
  - Ignore definitions of `\pandocbounded`, `\pandocfootnotemark`, and `\pandocfootnotetext` (e.g. from pandoc’s template), which the reader handles directly. Previously these definitions were expanded, producing garbage and losing content.
  - Fix file-crossing bug in `rawLaTeXParser` (#12072). The raw LaTeX parser didn’t work properly when crossing from one source file to another.

- Typst reader:

  - Handle `columns: auto` in grid (#12061).

- HTML reader:

  - Don’t drop ordered lists and rules inside footnotes (#11852). Previously an `<ol>` inside the body of a note was treated as the list of notes, and its items were lost. Similarly, an `<hr>` inside a note was dropped.

- RST reader:

  - Strip minimum indentation from indented blocks (#12071). Previously the indentation of the first line was stripped, so lines with less indentation lost all their leading whitespace. Now, as in docutils, the minimum indentation is stripped and relative indentation is preserved.
  - Require descriptions in option list items (#12063).

- ODT reader:

  - Support the `styles` extension (#12060).

- Docx reader:

  - Merge adjacent styled code blocks (#9183, Caio Vinícius). Without `+styles`, consecutive “Source Code” paragraphs are combined into a single code block by `combineBlocks`. With `+styles`, each paragraph is first wrapped in a `Div` carrying its `custom-style` attribute, so the `CodeBlock` case no longer matched and every line became its own `Div [CodeBlock]`.
  - Don’t drop contents of customXml element (#12050).
  - Read all underline types (#11988, Patrick Creighton).
  - Follow `w:numStyleLink` in abstract numberings (#9222, Caio Vinícius).

- Pptx reader:

  - Don’t add spaces between text runs (#12016, Nacho García).
  - Read the shapes inside group shapes (#12017, Nacho García).
  - Read equations and markup-compatibility blocks (#12025, Nacho Garcia).
  - Read speaker notes (Nacho García, #12023). Each slide’s notes are now read into a `notes` div at the end of the slide’s blocks, the form the pptx writer turns into speaker notes, so pptx -\> Markdown -\> pptx keeps them.
  - Read charts as tables (Nacho García, #12023). Previously, a chart was read as a placeholder text. We now create a table from the chart’s cached data. The table is put in a `chart` Div whose `type` attribute holds the chart type. The chart’s title becomes the table captions. The chart code is in Text.Pandoc.Readers.OOXML.Charts.
  - Mark hidden slides with a `hidden` class on the header (Nacho García, #12023).
  - Handle merged table cells (Nacho García).
  - Parse bold, italic, sub/superscript and hyperlinks (Nacho García). Text runs were previously read as plain text, so their formatting and hyperlinks were lost.
  - Read inherited bullets, numbering and nested lists (#12042, Nacho García).
  - Skip slide number placeholders (#12045, Nacho García).

- Xlsx reader:

  - Resolve package-absolute relationship targets (#12013, Nacho García).
  - Read inline strings and rich text as written (#12014, Nacho García).
  - Look up a cell’s font through its cell format (#12033, Nacho García).
  - Read merged cells as spans (Nacho García).
  - Render dates and times (Nacho García).
  - Render numbers as Excel’s General format (Nacho García, #12023).
  - Read charts (#12043, Nacho García). Charts are now read as tables using the cached data.

- Docx writer:

  - Implement flip-flopping for emph (#11961). Emph within emph becomes upright. This is important for correct formatting of titles in CSL, among other things. LaTeX does this automatically, and in HTML we achieve it via CSS.

- EPUB writer:

  - Fix `id` clash with added title header (#12003, Alain Lesage).
  - Skip dates that cannot be normalized (#12002, Alain Lesage).

- Ipynb writer:

  - Make ANSI escape stripping linear (#7744, Jeremy Levartovsky).

- Vimwiki reader:

  - Support rejected todos (tyler000000).

- LaTeX writer:

  - Fix hyperlinks for deferred footnotes (#11936). Notes in tables, captions, and definition list terms are rendered as a mark followed later by the note text. Previously we used `\footnotemark{}` and `\footnotetext` with manual adjustments to the footnote counter. But hyperref anchors each `\footnotetext` at the destination of the most recent `\footnotemark`, so when there were several such notes, all of the texts got the last mark’s anchor and the links for the other marks were broken. We now emit `\pandocfootnotemark{n}` and `\pandocfootnotetext{n}{..}`, where `n` is a unique id. These macros, defined in the default template when the `deferred-notes` variable is set, save the footnote mark and hyperref anchor at the mark and restore them at the text. This removes the need for counter arithmetic, works when the footnote counter is reset by chapter, and handles notes nested inside deferred notes (whose texts are now emitted after the text containing their marks). **Note:** Users of custom LaTeX templates, or of LaTeX fragments produced without `--standalone`, will need to include the definitions of `\pandocfootnotemark` and `\pandocfootnotetext` from the default template.
  - Allow repeated longtable captions (#4558, Václav Haisman). If a table has a `repeat-caption` class, captions will be repeated on each page of a longtable.

- HTML styles template:

  - Add emph flip-flopping. So, emph within emph renders as upright, etc.
  - Move `@print` rules to end (#12064), so they aren’t overridden.

- Text.Pandoc.PDF:

  - PDF via LaTeX: do at most 3 runs when only a TOC is present (#12012, Alain Lesage).

- Text.Pandoc.Class:

  - Export new functions `getDataDirs` and `getPandocDataDirs`. \[API change\]

- Text.Pandoc.Citeproc:

  - `removeFinalPeriod` now acts across Link boundary.

- pandoc-lua-engine: raise lower bound for pandoc to 3.13 (#12066).

- Depend on texmath 0.13.3.5, commonmark 0.3.2, commonmark-extensions 0.2.8, citeproc 0.14.2, typst 0.12.1, emojis 0.1.6, skylighting 0.15.0.1.

- New bounds for crypton in pandoc-lua-engine and pandoc.

- Makefile:

  - Fix release-templates target so it pushes tags.
  - Remove default CABALOPTS. These can be put in cabal.project.local. This will ensure that the same options are used by HLS, so that rebuilds aren’t needed.
  - `make check-cabal`: exit with error status on outdated deps.
  - Reorganize `check-cabal`; add `check-sdist` target we can run separately.

- cabal.project: specify `+http` flag for all ghc versions.

- Minimize the test docx, odt, pptx files. This reduces the size of the test files (and release tarball) by 1.79 MB.

</details>
